about.datasetCredit.text: Tag rekomendasi dan judul serupa sebagian dari Portico Title Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0), yang dibuat dari Wikipedia dan Wikidata.
about.datasetCredit.source: Recommendation tags and similar titles in part from the Portico Title Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0), built from Wikipedia and Wikidata.

about.legal.text: Syarat Penggunaan dan Kebijakan Privasi: getportico.tv/terms dan getportico.tv/privacy. Metadata dan artwork disediakan oleh TMDB dan penyedia lain yang dikonfigurasi di server Anda.
about.legal.source: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: getportico.tv/terms and getportico.tv/privacy. Metadata and artwork are provided by TMDB and other providers configured on your server.

about.report.afterCrash.text: Portico tertutup tak terduga terakhir kali. Laporan akan mencakup apa yang salah.
about.report.afterCrash.source: Portico closed unexpectedly last time. A report would include what went wrong.

about.report.confirmBody.text: Laporan berisi apa yang dicatat aplikasi ini saat terjadi masalah. Itu dapat mencakup nama judul dan perangkat ini. Tidak pernah mencakup kata sandi atau data masuk Anda.
about.report.confirmBody.source: It holds what this app logged while something went wrong. That can include the names of titles and of this device. It never includes your password or sign-in.

about.report.confirmTitle.source: Send a report to the owner of {server}?

about.report.failed.text: Laporan tidak dapat dikirim. Coba lagi nanti.
about.report.failed.source: The report couldn’t be sent. Try again later.

about.report.help.text: Mengirim peringatan dan error terbaru aplikasi ini ke pemilik {server}, untuk membantu menemukan masalah.
about.report.help.source: Sends this app’s recent warnings and errors to the owner of {server}, to help find a problem.

about.report.sent.source: The report was sent to the owner of {server}.

account.delete.affects.source: Your profiles on {servers} are removed too.

account.delete.changed.text: Ada yang berubah sejak Anda membuka ini. Tinjau lagi, lalu hapus.
account.delete.changed.source: Something changed since you opened this. Review it again, then delete.

account.delete.consequence.text: Tindakan ini menghapus akun Anda dan semua profilnya untuk selamanya. Tidak dapat diurungkan.
account.delete.consequence.source: This deletes your account and all its profiles for good. It can’t be undone.

account.delete.mismatch.text: Itu tidak cocok dengan email akun Anda. Ketik persis seperti yang tertera di akun Anda.
account.delete.mismatch.source: That doesn’t match your account email. Type it exactly as it appears on your account.

account.delete.ownsServers.text: Anda masih memiliki {servers}. Alihkan atau hapus dulu, lalu kembali ke sini.
account.delete.ownsServers.source: You still own {servers}. Transfer or remove them first, then come back here.

account.delete.typeEmail.text: Ketik email akun Anda untuk mengonfirmasi
account.delete.typeEmail.source: Type your account email to confirm

account.delete.typeEmailHelp.text: Jika akun Anda tidak memiliki email, ketik nama pengguna Anda.
account.delete.typeEmailHelp.source: If your account has no email, type your username.

account.hostedManagedAt.text: Kata sandi, metode masuk, perangkat, dan keamanan akun dikelola di Portico Account Anda di web.
account.hostedManagedAt.source: Password, sign-in methods, devices and account security are managed in your Portico Account on the web.

account.manageHostedHelp.text: Kata sandi, metode masuk, dan keamanan

account.onlyMainProfileManages.text: Profil, PIN, dan batas dikelola dari profil utama.
account.onlyMainProfileManages.source: Profiles, PINs and limits are managed from the main profile.

account.passwordTooLong.text: Kata sandi ini terlalu panjang. Gunakan lebih sedikit karakter.
account.passwordTooLong.source: This password is too long. Use fewer characters.

account.signOutEverywhere.body.text: Setiap perangkat yang masuk ke akun ini, termasuk yang ini, harus masuk lagi.
account.signOutEverywhere.body.source: Every device signed in to this account, including this one, will need to sign in again.

account.switchFromServers.text: Ganti profil dari Server, tempat Anda memilih server dan profil sekaligus.
account.switchFromServers.source: Switch profiles from Servers, where you pick the server and profile together.

account.tvHandoffTitle.text: Kelola profil, PIN, dan verifikasi dua langkah di ponsel atau komputer Anda
account.tvHandoffTitle.source: Manage profiles, PINs and two-step verification on your phone or computer

accountSessions.error.load.text: Sesi akun Anda tidak dapat dimuat.
accountSessions.error.load.source: Your account sessions couldn’t be loaded.

accountSessions.youWereSignedOut.text: Sesi akun ini telah berakhir. Masuk lagi.
accountSessions.youWereSignedOut.source: This account session has ended. Sign in again.

activation.codeFailed.text: Kode tidak dapat dibuat saat ini.
activation.codeFailed.source: A code couldn’t be made right now.

activation.codeRefreshes.text: Kode ini diperbarui dengan sendirinya. Biarkan layar ini terbuka saat Anda masuk.
activation.codeRefreshes.source: This code refreshes by itself. Leave this screen open while you sign in.

activation.declined.text: Proses masuk ditolak di perangkat lain. Dapatkan kode baru untuk mencoba lagi.
activation.declined.source: The sign-in was declined on the other device. Get a new code to try again.

activation.failed.text: Portico tidak dapat memperoleh kode masuk. Periksa koneksi Anda, lalu dapatkan kode baru.
activation.failed.source: Portico couldn’t get a sign-in code. Check your connection, then get a new code.

activation.lead.text: Pindai kode QR, atau kunjungi {host} dan masukkan kode. Masuk dengan Google, Apple, atau Portico Account Anda di browser.
activation.lead.source: Scan the QR code, or visit {host} and enter the code. Sign in with Google, Apple, or your Portico Account in the browser.

activation.termsNote.text: Dengan melanjutkan, Anda menyetujui syarat dan kebijakan privasi Portico. Syarat: getportico.tv/terms • Privasi: getportico.tv/privacy
activation.termsNote.source:
By continuing, you agree to Portico’s terms and privacy policy.
Terms: getportico.tv/terms  •  Privacy: getportico.tv/privacy

api.credential.ended.member_disabled.text: Berhenti berfungsi saat orang ini dinonaktifkan.
api.credential.ended.member_disabled.source: It stopped working when this person was disabled.

api.credential.ended.profile_deleted.source: It stopped working when its profile was deleted.

api.credential.ended.unavailable.text: Tidak lagi berfungsi. Buat yang baru.
api.credential.ended.unavailable.source: It no longer works. Create a new one.

api.credential.expiryDays.text: Dalam {count, plural, one {# hari} other {# hari}}
api.credential.expiryDays.source: In {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

api.credential.hideEnded.source: Hide the ones that no longer work

api.credential.limitNote.text: Setiap kunci atau token boleh membuat {count} permintaan per menit.
api.credential.limitNote.source: Each key or token may make {count} requests a minute.

api.credential.secretNotShown.text: Kunci dibuat, tetapi tidak dapat ditampilkan lagi di sini. Cabut dan buat yang lain.
api.credential.secretNotShown.source: It was created, but it can’t be shown again here. Revoke it and create another.

api.credential.showEnded.text: {count, plural, one {Tampilkan # yang tidak lagi berfungsi} other {Tampilkan # yang tidak lagi berfungsi}}
api.credential.showEnded.source: {count, plural, one {Show # that no longer works} other {Show # that no longer work}}

api.credential.state.awaiting_approval.source: Waiting for the owner to approve it

api.mcp.addressHelp.text: Ini alamat yang Anda pakai sekarang. Asisten yang berjalan di tempat lain memerlukan alamat yang menjangkau server ini dari sana.
api.mcp.addressHelp.source: This is the address you are using now. An assistant running somewhere else needs an address that reaches this server from there.

api.mcp.key.source: The key it signs in with

api.mcp.keyHelp.text: Buat kunci API hanya dengan yang boleh dilakukan asisten, dan berikan kepada asisten beserta alamatnya. Anggota dapat memakai token akses pribadi miliknya sebagai gantinya.
api.mcp.keyHelp.source: Create an API key with only what the assistant should be able to do, and give it to the assistant with the address. A member can use a personal access token of their own instead.

api.mcp.lede.text: Biarkan asisten AI bekerja dengan server ini. Beri alamat ini dan kunci API atau token akses pribadi; asisten hanya dapat memakai yang diizinkan kunci itu.
api.mcp.lede.source: Let an AI assistant work with this server. Give it this address and an API key or personal access token; it can use only what that key allows.

api.scope.admin.help.text: Semua yang dapat Anda lakukan sendiri, termasuk pengaturan server, profil, anggota, dan perangkat.
api.scope.admin.help.source: Everything you can do yourself, including server settings, profiles, members and devices.

api.scope.library.help.text: Pindai, cocokkan, edit, dan hapus isi pustaka.
api.scope.library.help.source: Scan, match, edit and delete what is in the libraries.

api.scope.playback.help.text: Putar, kontrol pemutaran, dan ubah status tontonan, daftar, preferensi, dan rekaman Anda sendiri.
api.scope.playback.help.source: Play, control playback, and change your own watch state, lists, preferences and recordings.

api.scope.read.help.text: Lihat pustaka, judul, panduan, dan status tontonan Anda sendiri.
api.scope.read.help.source: Look at libraries, titles, the guide and your own watch state.

api.scopes.note.text: Kunci atau token tidak pernah dapat melakukan lebih dari pembuatnya, dan tidak pernah dapat masuk, mengubah kata sandi, atau membuat kunci lain. Kunci juga berfungsi di akhir alamat, sehingga artwork, stream, dan unduhan terbuka sendiri.
api.scopes.note.source: A key or token can never do more than the person who made it, and it can never sign in, change a password or make another key. It also works at the end of an address, so artwork, streams and downloads open on their own.

api.tokens.lede.text: Untuk skrip dan aplikasi Anda sendiri. Token masuk sebagai Anda dan hanya dapat melakukan yang Anda izinkan saat membuatnya.
api.tokens.lede.source: For your own scripts and apps. A token signs in as you and can do only what you allow when you create it.

api.tokens.lifetime.text: Kunci dan token tetap berfungsi saat Anda mengubah kata sandi atau keluar di semua tempat. Kunci berhenti saat Anda mencabutnya, saat kedaluwarsa, atau saat pembuatnya dinonaktifkan atau dihapus.
api.tokens.lifetime.source: Keys and tokens keep working when you change your password or sign out everywhere. They stop when you revoke them, when they expire, or when the person who made them is disabled or removed.

api.tokens.memberLede.text: Token yang dibuat anggota untuk skrip dan aplikasi mereka sendiri. Anda dapat mengakhiri salah satunya.
api.tokens.memberLede.source: Tokens that members have made for their own scripts and apps. You can end any of them.

api.tokens.off.text: Pemilik server ini mematikan token akses pribadi.
api.tokens.off.source: The owner of this server has turned off personal access tokens.

api.tokens.revokeBody.text: Apa pun yang memakai token ini berhenti berfungsi sekaligus. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
api.tokens.revokeBody.source: Anything using this token stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

api.tokens.shownOnce.text: Ini satu-satunya saat token ditampilkan. Server menyimpan sidik jari, bukan tokennya.
api.tokens.shownOnce.source: This is the only time the token is shown. The server keeps a fingerprint, not the token.

api.webhooks.dropped.text: {count, plural, one {# peristiwa tidak} other {# peristiwa tidak}} disimpan karena terlalu banyak yang sudah menunggu.
api.webhooks.dropped.source: {count, plural, one {# event was} other {# events were}} not kept because too many were already waiting.

api.webhooks.error.certificate_not_trust.text: Sertifikat keamanan layanan lain tidak dapat diperiksa.
api.webhooks.error.certificate_not_trust.source: The other service’s security certificate could not be checked.

api.webhooks.error.could_not_connect.text: Server ini tidak dapat tersambung ke alamat itu.
api.webhooks.error.could_not_connect.source: This server could not connect to that address.

api.webhooks.error.payload_too_large.source: The message was too large to send.

api.webhooks.error.redirect_not_followed.text: Layanan lain mengarahkan server ini ke tempat lain. Pakai alamat akhirnya.
api.webhooks.error.redirect_not_followed.source: The other service sent this server somewhere else. Use the final address.

api.webhooks.error.request_failed.source: The message could not be sent.

api.webhooks.error.status.source: The other service answered with an error ({status}).

api.webhooks.error.timed_out.source: The other service took too long to answer.

api.webhooks.error.webhook_turned_off.source: The webhook was turned off before this was sent.

api.webhooks.event.update.available.source: A new version of Portico is available

api.webhooks.failing.text: {count, plural, one {pengiriman terakhir} other {# pengiriman terakhir}} tidak sampai.
api.webhooks.failing.source: The last {count, plural, one {delivery} other {# deliveries}} did not arrive.

api.webhooks.full.text: Server ini menyimpan hingga {count} webhook. Hapus satu untuk menambah yang lain.
api.webhooks.full.source: This server keeps up to {count} webhooks. Remove one to add another.

api.webhooks.lede.text: Kirim pesan ke layanan lain saat sesuatu terjadi di server ini. Pesan hanya dikirim oleh server ini.
api.webhooks.lede.source: Send a message to another service when something happens on this server. Messages are sent by this server only.

api.webhooks.removeBody.text: Tidak ada lagi yang dikirim ke sana, dan log pengiriman serta semua yang masih menunggu dihapus.
api.webhooks.removeBody.source: Nothing more is sent to it, and its delivery log and anything still waiting are removed.

api.webhooks.rotateBody.text: Pesan ditandatangani dengan rahasia baru mulai sekarang. Berikan kepada layanan lain, atau layanan itu berhenti memercayainya.
api.webhooks.rotateBody.source: Messages are signed with the new secret from now on. Give it to the other service, or it will stop trusting them.

api.webhooks.secretHelp.text: Biarkan kosong dan Portico membuatkan satu lalu menunjukkannya sekali kepada Anda.
api.webhooks.secretHelp.source: Leave empty and Portico makes one and shows it to you once.

api.webhooks.secretKept.text: Rahasia penandatanganan tetap seperti semula (berakhiran {hint}). Untuk mengubahnya, pilih Ganti rahasia dari menu webhook.
api.webhooks.secretKept.source: The signing secret stays as it is (it ends in {hint}). To change it, choose Replace the secret from the webhook’s menu.

api.webhooks.secretShownOnce.text: Ini satu-satunya saat rahasia ditampilkan. Layanan lain memakainya untuk memeriksa bahwa pesan benar-benar berasal dari server ini.
api.webhooks.secretShownOnce.source: This is the only time the secret is shown. The other service uses it to check that a message really came from this server.

api.webhooks.testQueued.text: Uji sedang dikirim. Hasilnya tampil di log pengiriman.
api.webhooks.testQueued.source: A test is on its way. Its result will appear in the delivery log.

api.webhooks.urlHelp.text: Tempat mengirim setiap pesan. Alamat di jaringan Anda sendiri boleh dipakai.
api.webhooks.urlHelp.source: Where to send each message. An address on your own network is fine.

api.webhooks.urlProblem.text: Pakai alamat web lengkap yang diawali http:// atau https:// dan tanpa nama pengguna atau kata sandi di dalamnya.
api.webhooks.urlProblem.source: Use a full web address that starts with http:// or https:// and has no user name or password in it.

api.webhooks.waiting.text: {count, plural, one {# pesan} other {# pesan}} menunggu dikirim
api.webhooks.waiting.source: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} waiting to be sent

auth.accountLead.text: Masuk dengan Portico Account Anda untuk mengakses server yang dibagikan kepada Anda.
auth.accountLead.source: Sign in with your Portico Account to access servers shared with you.

auth.agreeToTerms.source: By continuing, you agree to the

auth.codeSentTo.text: Kami mengirim kode ke {address}. Masukkan untuk menyelesaikan pembuatan akun Anda.
auth.codeSentTo.source: We sent a code to {address}. Enter it to finish creating your account.

auth.direct.lead.text: Gunakan akun yang ada di server Anda. Akun itu hanya dipakai antara perangkat ini dan server itu.
auth.direct.lead.source: Use an account that lives on your server. It stays between this device and that server.

auth.direct.leadTV.text: Masukkan alamat server Anda. Lalu setujui TV ini dari ponsel atau komputer yang sudah masuk. Tidak ada kata sandi yang perlu diketik.
auth.direct.leadTV.source: Enter your server’s address. Then approve this TV from a phone or computer that’s already signed in. There’s no password to type.

auth.hostedUnreachable.text: Portico Account Anda tidak dapat dijangkau saat ini.
auth.hostedUnreachable.source: Couldn’t reach your Portico Account just now.

auth.noPasswordForSocial.text: Jika Anda mendaftar dengan Google atau Apple, tidak ada kata sandi Portico yang perlu diatur ulang: masuk dengan tombol itu saja.
auth.noPasswordForSocial.source: If you signed up with Google or Apple, there is no Portico password to reset: sign in with that button instead.

auth.offlineDownloadsBody.source: Watch your downloads without a connection.

auth.offlineDownloadsLede.text: Ini diputar tanpa koneksi. Masuk untuk mengunduh lebih banyak.
auth.offlineDownloadsLede.source: These play without a connection. Sign in to download more.

auth.oneAccount.text: Satu Portico Account menjangkau setiap server yang Anda miliki atau yang dibagikan kepada Anda.
auth.oneAccount.source: One Portico Account reaches every server you own or that someone shares with you.

auth.privacySameAnswer.text: Demi privasi Anda jawabannya sama baik ada maupun tidak ada akun yang cocok.
auth.privacySameAnswer.source: For your privacy the answer is the same whether or not an account matches.

auth.resetLinkLede.text: Masukkan nama pengguna dan email di akun Anda. Kami akan mengirimi Anda tautan untuk mengatur ulang kata sandi.
auth.resetLinkLede.source: Enter your username and the email on your account. We’ll email you a link to reset your password.

auth.resetLinkLedeEmail.text: Masukkan email di akun Anda. Kami akan mengirimi Anda tautan untuk mengatur ulang kata sandi.
auth.resetLinkLedeEmail.source: Enter the email on your account. We’ll email you a link to reset your password.

auth.resetLinkSent.text: Kami telah mengirim tautan untuk mengatur ulang kata sandi Anda. Buka di perangkat mana pun, lalu masuk di sini dengan kata sandi baru Anda.
auth.resetLinkSent.source: We’ve sent a link to reset your password. Open it on any device, then sign in here with your new password.

auth.savedUnreachable.text: Saat ini tidak dapat dijangkau. Portico terus mencoba.
auth.savedUnreachable.source: Couldn’t reach it just now. Portico keeps trying.

auth.signInDirectly.source: Sign in directly to a server

auth.signInWithAccount.source: Sign in with a Portico Account

auth.tvGoogleHint.text: Untuk masuk dengan Google, kembali dan pindai kode dengan ponsel Anda.
auth.tvGoogleHint.source: To sign in with Google, go back and scan the code with your phone.

auth.useCodeFromAnotherDevice.source: Use a code from another device

auth.usernameHelp.text: Huruf, angka, titik, dan strip. Orang memakainya untuk berbagi server dengan Anda.
auth.usernameHelp.source: Letters, numbers, dots and dashes. People use it to share a server with you.

builder.audience.text: Semua orang dengan akses ke pustaka ini melihat saluran ini.
builder.audience.source: Everyone with access to these libraries sees this channel.

builder.empty.body.text: Saluran Pustaka memutar film dan acara Anda sendiri terjadwal, seperti saluran TV. Jelaskan yang diputarnya, seperti “hanya film dari 1985” atau “tidak lain selain satu acara”.
builder.empty.body.source: A Library Channel plays your own movies and shows on a schedule, like a TV channel. Describe what it plays, like “only movies from 1985” or “nothing but one show”.

builder.episodes.marathon.source: Marathon: one show at a time

builder.episodes.rotate.source: One episode of each show in turn

builder.error.conditions.text: Salah satu kondisi ini tidak dapat dipakai. Ubah atau hapus.
builder.error.conditions.source: One of these conditions can’t be used. Change or remove it.

builder.error.kinds.text: Pilih film, acara TV, atau keduanya.
builder.error.kinds.source: Choose movies, TV shows, or both.

builder.error.pins.text: Salah satu judul ini tidak dapat disematkan. Hapus, lalu coba lagi.
builder.error.pins.source: One of these titles can’t be pinned. Remove it, then try again.

builder.error.preview.text: Pratinjau tidak dapat dibuat. Perubahan Anda disimpan.
builder.error.preview.source: The preview couldn’t be made. Your changes are kept.

builder.error.rejected.text: Server tidak menerima saluran ini. Periksa nama, pustaka, kondisi, dan zona waktunya, lalu coba lagi.
builder.error.rejected.source: The server didn’t accept this channel. Check its name, libraries, conditions and time zone, then try again.

builder.error.save.text: Saluran tidak dapat disimpan. Periksa kolom yang disorot, lalu coba lagi.
builder.error.save.source: The channel couldn’t be saved. Check the highlighted field, then try again.

builder.error.timeZone.source: Enter a time zone like America/New_York.

builder.hours.text: Sekitar {hours, plural, one {# jam} other {# jam}} program
builder.hours.source: About {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} of programming

builder.matches.text: {count, plural, =0 {Tidak ada judul yang cocok} one {# judul cocok} other {# judul cocok}}
builder.matches.source: {count, plural, =0 {No titles match} one {# title matches} other {# titles match}}

builder.mentionsHint.text: Kata, seperti “hiu”. Setiap kata harus muncul.
builder.mentionsHint.source: Words, like “shark”. Every word must appear.

builder.noConditions.text: Tanpa kondisi: semua di pustaka terpilih diputar.
builder.noConditions.source: No conditions: everything in the chosen libraries plays.

builder.noMatchesHelp.text: Longgarkan kondisi, atau pilih lebih banyak pustaka.
builder.noMatchesHelp.source: Loosen a condition, or choose more libraries.

builder.noVideoLibraries.text: Tambahkan pustaka film atau TV terlebih dahulu.
builder.noVideoLibraries.source: Add a movie or TV library first.

builder.opaqueConditions.text: Saluran ini memakai kondisi yang tidak dapat ditampilkan pembuat. Kondisi dibiarkan apa adanya.
builder.opaqueConditions.source: This channel uses conditions the builder can’t show. They’re kept as they are.

builder.previewEmpty.text: Pilih pustaka untuk melihat yang akan diputar.
builder.previewEmpty.source: Choose a library to see what would play.

builder.showsNote.text: Untuk acara TV, kondisi berlaku untuk acara (genre, jaringan, rating-nya) dan setiap episode diputar.
builder.showsNote.source: For TV shows, conditions apply to the show (its genre, network, rating) and every episode plays.

builder.unresolved.text: {count, plural, one {# judul belum dapat dijadwalkan (durasinya belum diketahui)} other {# judul belum dapat dijadwalkan (durasinya belum diketahui)}}
builder.unresolved.source: {count, plural, one {# title can’t be scheduled yet (its length isn’t known)} other {# titles can’t be scheduled yet (their length isn’t known)}}

card.keyboardHint.text: Tekan M untuk tindakan lainnya, P untuk memutar.
card.keyboardHint.source: Press M for more actions, P to play.

cast.error.busy.text: Ada orang lain yang memutar di TV ini saat ini.
cast.error.busy.source: Someone else is playing on this TV right now.

cast.error.loadFailed.text: TV tidak dapat memutar judul ini.
cast.error.loadFailed.source: The TV couldn’t play this title.

cast.error.lostPairing.text: TV kehilangan koneksi ke perangkat ini. Cast lagi untuk menyambung ulang.
cast.error.lostPairing.source: The TV lost its connection to this device. Cast again to reconnect.

cast.error.noAnswer.source: The TV didn’t answer. Try again.

cast.error.noCode.text: Server tidak mengeluarkan kode penyambungan. Coba lagi.
cast.error.noCode.source: The server didn’t issue a pairing code. Try again.

cast.error.refused.text: TV tidak menerima koneksi. Coba lagi.
cast.error.refused.source: The TV didn’t accept the connection. Try again.

cast.error.tvBusy.text: Ada yang menonton di TV ini dan tidak mengizinkan Anda mengambil alih.
cast.error.tvBusy.source: Someone is watching on this TV and didn’t let you take over.

cast.error.unreachable.text: TV tidak dapat dijangkau. Coba lagi.
cast.error.unreachable.source: The TV couldn’t be reached. Try again.

cast.takeover.body.source: {requester} wants to play on the TV. Allow?

cast.takeover.title.text: Ada yang ingin memutar di TV
cast.takeover.title.source: Someone wants to play on the TV

cast.waitingForAllow.source: Waiting for the person watching to allow it

channels.emptyMember.text: Minta pemilik server menyelesaikan penyiapan sumber ini.
channels.emptyMember.source: Ask the server owner to finish setting up this source.

channels.emptyOwner.text: Saluran tampil setelah pemuatan ulang panduan berikutnya.
channels.emptyOwner.source: Channels appear after the next guide refresh.

error.account.unreachable.source: Portico can’t reach your Portico Account right now. Check your internet connection, then try again.

error.account.unreachableRetrying.text: Portico tidak dapat menjangkau Portico Account Anda saat ini. Portico akan terus mencoba.
error.account.unreachableRetrying.source: Portico can’t reach your Portico Account right now. It will keep trying.

error.artworkGone.text: Artwork ini tidak lagi tersedia. Muat ulang untuk melihat yang terbaru.
error.artworkGone.source: This artwork is no longer available. Refresh to see the latest.

error.artworkPending.text: Artwork ini belum siap. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
error.artworkPending.source: This artwork isn’t ready yet. Try again in a moment.

error.busy.text: Server Anda sedang sibuk saat ini. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
error.busy.source: Your server is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

error.changed.text: Ini berubah saat Anda melihatnya. Muat ulang untuk melihat yang terbaru.
error.changed.source: This changed while you were looking at it. Refresh to see the latest.

error.confirmationMismatch.text: Yang Anda ketik tidak cocok. Periksa dan coba lagi.
error.confirmationMismatch.source: What you typed doesn’t match. Check it and try again.

error.credentialLimit.text: Server ini sudah menyimpan kredensial sejenis ini sebanyak mungkin. Cabut salah satu yang tidak lagi Anda gunakan, lalu coba lagi.
error.credentialLimit.source: This server already has as many of these as it keeps. Revoke one you no longer use, then try again.

error.invalidInput.text: Beberapa detail tidak diterima. Periksa dan coba lagi.
error.invalidInput.source: Some details weren’t accepted. Check them and try again.

error.invalidResponse.text: Server Anda mengirim sesuatu yang tidak dapat dibaca Portico. Periksa bahwa server Anda sudah mutakhir.
error.invalidResponse.source: Your server sent something Portico couldn’t read. Check that your server is up to date.

error.live.credentials.text: Penyedia tidak menerima nama pengguna dan kata sandi itu. Masukkan lagi dan periksa sumber lagi.
error.live.credentials.source: The provider didn’t accept that username and password. Enter them again and check the source again.

error.live.hasDependencies.text: Rekaman, aturan rekaman, atau yang sedang diputar masih memakai sumber ini. Jeda saja, atau hapus itu terlebih dahulu.
error.live.hasDependencies.source: Recordings, recording rules or something playing still use this source. Pause it instead, or remove those first.

error.live.invalidInput.text: Playlist atau panduan tidak dapat dipakai. Periksa alamat dan coba lagi.
error.live.invalidInput.source: The playlist or guide couldn’t be used. Check the addresses and try again.

error.live.networkPolicy.text: Alamat ini ada di jaringan rumah Anda. Konfirmasi hanya jika Anda memercayai perangkat.
error.live.networkPolicy.source: This address is on your home network. Confirm it only if you trust the device.

error.live.previewExpired.text: Sumber ini berubah, atau diperiksa terlalu lama lalu. Periksa sumber lagi.
error.live.previewExpired.source: This source changed, or it was checked too long ago. Check the source again.

error.live.tunersBusy.text: Semua tuner sumber ini sedang ditonton atau disimpan untuk rekaman.
error.live.tunersBusy.source: All of this source’s tuners are being watched or kept for recordings.

error.live.unavailable.text: Sumber tidak dapat dijangkau, atau menjawab dengan yang tidak dapat dibaca Portico. Panduan yang sudah Anda miliki disimpan.
error.live.unavailable.source: The source couldn’t be reached, or answered with something Portico can’t read. The guide you already have is kept.

error.localMetadataOnly.text: Pustaka ini hanya memakai metadata lokal. Ubah sumber metadatanya untuk mencari daring.
error.localMetadataOnly.source: This library uses local metadata only. Change its metadata source to look things up online.

error.metadataUnavailable.text: Metadata untuk sementara tidak tersedia. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
error.metadataUnavailable.source: Metadata is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

error.methodNotAllowed.text: Tindakan ini tidak didukung di sini.

error.notFound.text: Ini tidak tersedia lagi. Mungkin telah dihapus, atau akses Anda mungkin telah berubah.
error.notFound.source: This isn’t available anymore. It may have been removed, or your access may have changed.

error.offline.text: Perangkat ini luring. Periksa koneksi Anda, lalu coba lagi.
error.offline.source: This device is offline. Check your connection, then try again.

error.offlineRetrying.text: Perangkat ini luring. Portico akan menyambung ulang segera setelah memungkinkan.
error.offlineRetrying.source: This device is offline. Portico will reconnect as soon as it can.

error.permission.text: Profil Anda tidak memiliki akses ke ini. Tanyakan kepada pemilik server jika menurut Anda seharusnya punya.
error.permission.source: Your profile doesn’t have access to this. Ask the server’s owner if you think it should.

error.playbackConversionCapacity.text: Server ini sudah mengonversi stream sebanyak yang diizinkan. Tunggu sebentar atau hentikan stream lain, lalu coba lagi.
error.playbackConversionCapacity.source: This server is already converting as many streams as it is allowed. Wait a moment or stop another stream, then try again.

error.queueTooLarge.text: Antrean ini terlalu panjang. Hapus sebagian atau mulai yang baru.
error.queueTooLarge.source: This queue is too long. Remove some of it or start a new one.

error.rateLimited.text: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Tunggu sebentar, lalu coba lagi.
error.rateLimited.source: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

error.rateLimitedSeconds.text: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi dalam {seconds, plural, one {# detik} other {# detik}}.
error.rateLimitedSeconds.source: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

error.screenCrashed.source: Something went wrong on this screen.

error.storageFull.text: Server Anda kehabisan ruang penyimpanan. Kosongkan sebagian ruang, lalu coba lagi.
error.storageFull.source: Your server is out of storage space. Free some space, then try again.

error.timeout.text: Server Anda terlalu lama menjawab. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
error.timeout.source: Your server took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.

error.transportUnavailable.text: Perangkat ini tidak dapat mengirim detail masuk dengan aman dengan perangkat lunaknya saat ini. Gunakan aplikasi Portico lain.
error.transportUnavailable.source: This device can’t safely send sign-in details with its current software. Use another Portico app.

error.unavailable.text: Ini tidak tersedia di server Anda saat ini.
error.unavailable.source: This isn’t available on your server right now.

error.unconfirmedChange.text: Server Anda tidak mengonfirmasi perubahan. Muat ulang untuk memeriksa apakah perubahan disimpan.
error.unconfirmedChange.source: Your server didn’t confirm the change. Refresh to check whether it was saved.

error.unreachable.text: Portico tidak dapat menjangkau server Anda saat ini. Periksa bahwa server menyala dan terhubung, lalu coba lagi.
error.unreachable.source: Portico can’t reach your server right now. Check that it’s on and connected, then try again.

error.unreachableRetrying.text: Portico tidak dapat menjangkau server Anda saat ini. Portico akan terus mencoba.
error.unreachableRetrying.source: Portico can’t reach your server right now. It will keep trying.

error.unsupportedVersion.text: Server ini memerlukan Portico versi yang lebih baru. Perbarui aplikasi untuk melanjutkan.
error.unsupportedVersion.source: This server needs a newer version of Portico. Update the app to continue.

error.webUnavailable.text: Aplikasi web untuk sementara tidak tersedia. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
error.webUnavailable.source: The web app is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

error.webhookLimit.text: Server ini sudah menyimpan webhook sebanyak mungkin. Hapus salah satu yang tidak lagi Anda gunakan, lalu coba lagi.
error.webhookLimit.source: This server already has as many webhooks as it keeps. Remove one you no longer use, then try again.

feedback.diagnosticsHelp.text: Cara stream dikirim dan apa yang dilaporkan pemutar.
feedback.diagnosticsHelp.source: How the stream was delivered and what the player reported.

feedback.duplicateBody.text: Anda baru saja melaporkan ini, sehingga laporan ini ditambahkan ke laporan itu dan tidak dikirim lagi.
feedback.duplicateBody.source: You reported this recently, so it has been added to that report rather than sent again.

feedback.messagePlaceholder.text: Apa yang Anda lakukan, apa yang Anda harapkan, dan apa yang terjadi.
feedback.messagePlaceholder.source: What you were doing, what you expected, and what happened instead.

feedback.off.text: Umpan balik dimatikan untuk profil ini.
feedback.off.source: Feedback is turned off for this profile.

feedback.playbackDiagnostics.text: Sertakan detail teknis tentang pemutaran ini
feedback.playbackDiagnostics.source: Include technical details about this playback

feedback.playbackDiagnosticsHelp.text: Cara stream dikirim dan apa yang dilaporkan pemutar. Tanpa riwayat tontonan selain judul ini.
feedback.playbackDiagnosticsHelp.source: How the stream was delivered and what the player reported. No viewing history beyond this title.

feedback.sendFailed.text: Umpan balik Anda tidak dapat dikirim. Tidak ada yang hilang; coba lagi.
feedback.sendFailed.source: Your feedback couldn’t be sent. Nothing was lost; try again.

feedback.sentAs.text: Dikirim sebagai {name} kepada pemilik server ini.
feedback.sentAs.source: Sent as {name} to this server’s owner.

feedback.sentBody.text: Pemilik server kini dapat melihatnya. Balasan akan tiba di notifikasi Anda.
feedback.sentBody.source: The server’s owner can see it now. Any reply will arrive in your notifications.

feedback.tooShort.source: Describe it in at least {count} characters.

feedback.unavailable.text: Umpan balik tidak tersedia saat ini.

ffmpeg.validation.cannotRun.text: Build FFmpeg ini tidak dapat dijalankan dengan batasan proses server.
ffmpeg.validation.cannotRun.source: This FFmpeg build could not be run with the server’s process restrictions.

ffmpeg.validation.missingFeatures.text: Build FFmpeg ini tidak memiliki semua fitur media yang dibutuhkan Portico.
ffmpeg.validation.missingFeatures.source: This FFmpeg build does not have all the media features Portico needs.

ffmpeg.validation.timedOut.text: Memeriksa build FFmpeg ini terlalu lama. Coba lagi.
ffmpeg.validation.timedOut.source: Checking this FFmpeg build took too long. Try again.

ffmpeg.validation.unreadable.text: Berkas FFmpeg ini tidak dapat dibaca.
ffmpeg.validation.unreadable.source: This FFmpeg file could not be read.

guide.keyboardHint.text: Tombol panah bergerak, Enter membuka, W menonton, R merekam, N melompat ke sekarang.
guide.keyboardHint.source: Arrow keys move, Enter opens, W watches, R records, N jumps to now.

guide.minutesLeft.text: {count, plural, one {# mnt tersisa} other {# mnt tersisa}}
guide.minutesLeft.source: {count, plural, one {# min left} other {# min left}}

guide.onNowLeft.source: On now, {count, plural, one {# minute left} other {# minutes left}}

guide.reminderSet.text: Anda akan diingatkan 2 menit sebelum mulai, saat Portico terbuka.
guide.reminderSet.source: You’ll get a reminder 2 minutes before it starts, while Portico is open.

guide.seriesSet.text: Rekaman seri disiapkan. Tayangan baru ditambahkan saat panduan diperbarui.
guide.seriesSet.source: Series recording set up. New airings are added as the guide updates.

guide.stale.text: Panduan ini mungkin kedaluwarsa. Pemuatan ulang terakhir tidak selesai.
guide.stale.source: This guide may be out of date. The last refresh didn’t finish.

guide.tileFailed.text: Bagian panduan ini tidak dapat dimuat
guide.tileFailed.source: Couldn’t load this part of the guide

home.customize.chooseView.text: Pilih tampilan tersimpan untuk ditampilkan di Beranda.
home.customize.chooseView.source: Choose a saved view to show on Home.

home.customize.noViews.text: Tidak ada tampilan tersimpan untuk ditambahkan. Simpan dari filter pustaka.
home.customize.noViews.source: No saved views to add. Save one from a library’s filters.

home.customize.subtitle.text: Pilih baris yang tampil di Beranda. Seret baris untuk memindahkannya.
home.customize.subtitle.source: Choose which rows appear on Home. Drag a row to move it.

home.empty.ownerComputer.text: Pustaka ditambahkan di konsol server. Buka di browser pada komputer atau ponsel.
home.empty.ownerComputer.source: Libraries are added in the server console. Open it in a browser on a computer or phone.

home.row.topRated.text: Nilai tertinggi yang belum Anda tonton

invitation.joinWithAccount.text: Anda diundang ke {server}. Bergabung dengan Portico Account Anda dan server tersedia di semua perangkat Anda.
invitation.joinWithAccount.source: You’ve been invited to {server}. Join with your Portico Account and it’s on all your devices.

invitation.signInBody.text: Undangan diterima oleh Portico Account. Masuk dengan akun yang dikirimi undangan, lalu buka lagi tautannya.
invitation.signInBody.source: Invitations are accepted by a Portico Account. Sign in with the account the invitation was sent to, then open the link again.

invitation.signInTitle.text: Masuk dengan Portico Account untuk menerima
invitation.signInTitle.source: Sign in with a Portico Account to accept

invitations.accepted.text: Undangan diterima. Sambungkan ke server untuk memverifikasi akses.
invitations.accepted.source: Invitation accepted. Connect to the server to verify access.

invitations.mayHaveCompleted.text: Permintaan sebelumnya mungkin telah selesai. Periksa riwayat undangan yang dimuat ulang sebelum memulai yang lain.
invitations.mayHaveCompleted.source: The previous request may have finished. Check the refreshed invitation history before starting another.

invitations.membershipRemoved.text: Keanggotaan akun dihapus. Server yang tersambung menerapkan perubahan saat izinnya diperbarui.
invitations.membershipRemoved.source: Account membership removed. Connected servers apply the change when their permissions update.

invitations.sent.text: Undangan terkirim ke Portico Account mereka.
invitations.sent.source: Invitation sent to their Portico Account.

invite.body.text: Portico membuat tautan dan kode untuk server ini. Bagikan sendiri; Portico tidak mengirim email.
invite.body.source: Portico makes a link and a code for this server. Share them yourself; Portico sends no email.

invite.emailInvalid.source: That doesn’t look like an email address.

invite.readyBody.text: Bagikan tautannya, atau kodenya beserta alamat server ini. Undangan berlaku sekali.
invite.readyBody.source: Share the link, or the code with this server’s address. It works once.

invite.rowHelp.text: Tautan dan kode untuk dibagikan. Mereka bergabung dengan Portico Account mereka.
invite.rowHelp.source: A link and a code to share. They join with their Portico Account.

invite.shareMessage.text: Anda diundang ke {server} di Portico. Buka {link} untuk bergabung (atau gunakan kode {code}).
invite.shareMessage.source: You’re invited to {server} on Portico. Open {link} to join (or use the code {code}).

launch.reconnectingBody.text: Server Anda untuk sementara tidak tersedia. Portico akan membawa Anda kembali ke sini segera setelah tersambung ulang.
launch.reconnectingBody.source: Your server is temporarily unavailable. Portico will bring you back here as soon as it reconnects.

lib.saveViewLede.text: Filter dan urutan Anda saat ini, disimpan di Tersimpan.

library.emptyCollectionsBody.text: Koleksi mengelompokkan judul terkait, seperti seri film. Pemilik membuatnya dari menu judul mana pun dengan Tambahkan ke koleksi.
library.emptyCollectionsBody.source: Collections group related titles, like a film series. Owners create them from any title’s menu with Add to collection.

library.emptyLibraryBody.text: Saat server selesai memindai folder pustaka ini, judul-judulnya tampil di sini.
library.emptyLibraryBody.source: When the server finishes scanning this library’s folders, its titles appear here.

library.emptySeriesBody.text: Buku yang termasuk dalam seri dikelompokkan di sini.
library.emptySeriesBody.source: Books that belong to a series are grouped here.

library.emptyUnmatchedBody.text: Setiap album di pustaka ini memiliki artis. Album yang dibuat dari berkas tanpa tag tampil di sini.
library.emptyUnmatchedBody.source: Every album in this library has an artist. Albums made from untagged files appear here.

library.genres.emptyBody.text: Genre muncul saat musik Anda memiliki tag genre.
library.genres.emptyBody.source: Genres appear when your music has genre tags.

library.noMatchBody.source: Loosen a filter or clear them all.

licenses.notFound.text: Komponen ini tidak ada dalam daftar.
licenses.notFound.source: This component isn’t in the list.

server.people.blockBody.source: It is signed out at once and can’t use this server until you approve it again.

server.people.deleteBody.text: Tindakan ini menghapus akun {name}, {profiles, plural, one {# profil} other {# profil}} dan semua yang disimpan profil itu: progres tontonan, riwayat, daftar, dan playlist. {devices, plural, one {# perangkat dikeluarkan} other {# perangkat dikeluarkan}}. Tidak ada di pustaka Anda yang dihapus, dan rekaman disimpan.
server.people.deleteBody.source: This removes {name}’s account, {profiles, plural, one {# profile} other {# profiles}} and everything those profiles saved: watch progress, history, lists and playlists. {devices, plural, one {# device is} other {# devices are}} signed out. Nothing in your libraries is deleted, and recordings are kept.

server.people.deleteChanged.text: Akun orang ini berubah saat Anda melihatnya. Periksa lagi sebelum menghapus.
server.people.deleteChanged.source: This person’s account changed while you were looking. Check it again before deleting.

server.people.deleteHelp.text: Menghapusnya dari server ini untuk selamanya. Untuk menghentikan seseorang masuk tanpa menghapusnya, matikan akunnya saja.
server.people.deleteHelp.source: Removes them from this server for good. To stop someone signing in without removing them, turn their account off instead.

server.people.deleteHistoryKept.text: {count, plural, one {# pemutaran tetap ada di riwayat putar Anda, tanpa namanya.} other {# pemutaran tetap ada di riwayat putar Anda, tanpa namanya.}}
server.people.deleteHistoryKept.source: {count, plural, one {# play stays in your play history, without their name.} other {# plays stay in your play history, without their name.}}

server.people.deletePorticoAccount.text: Portico Account mereka tidak dihapus. Akun itu hanya berhenti menjadi anggota server ini.
server.people.deletePorticoAccount.source: Their Portico Account is not deleted. It just stops being a member of this server.

server.people.deviceApproval.source: New devices wait for your approval

server.people.deviceApprovalHelp.text: Perangkat yang masuk pertama kali tidak dapat menelusuri atau memutar hingga Anda menyetujuinya di sini. Perangkat yang sudah disetujui tidak terpengaruh.
server.people.deviceApprovalHelp.source: A device signing in for the first time can’t browse or play until you approve it here. Devices already approved are not affected.

server.people.hoursLede.text: Saat orang ini dapat masuk dan menonton. Tanpa jam yang diatur, kapan pun.
server.people.hoursLede.source: When this person can sign in and watch. With no hours set, any time.

server.people.hoursTimeHelp.source: Type a time, such as 8:30 or 20:15.

server.people.inviteCode.source: Or give them the code on its own: {code}

server.people.inviteRecipientHelp.text: Sebut satu Portico Account dan hanya akun itu yang dapat memakai undangan. Biarkan kosong dan siapa pun dengan tautan dapat memakainya.
server.people.inviteRecipientHelp.source: Name one Portico Account and only that account can use the invitation. Leave empty and anyone with the link can.

server.people.libraryGone.text: Pustaka yang tidak lagi ada di sini
server.people.libraryGone.source: A library that is no longer here

server.people.passwordWeak.text: Pilih kata sandi yang lebih panjang atau kurang umum.
server.people.passwordWeak.source: Choose a longer or less common password.

server.people.revokeInvitationBody.text: Tautan dan kode berhenti berfungsi sekaligus.
server.people.revokeInvitationBody.source: The link and the code stop working at once.

server.people.signInHelp.text: Atur kata sandi baru, atau matikan akun tanpa menghapusnya.
server.people.signInHelp.source: Set a new password, or turn the account off without removing it.

server.places.deleteCopyBody.text: Salinan hanya diperlukan untuk kembali ke versi sebelum peningkatan. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
server.places.deleteCopyBody.source: It is only needed to go back to the version before the upgrade. This cannot be undone.

server.places.lede.text: Folder ini dipilih saat server dimulai. Untuk mengubahnya, lihat panduan pemasangan.
server.places.lede.source: These folders are chosen when the server starts. To change one, see the installation guide.

server.places.reclaim.source: Space the database can give back

server.places.reclaimHelp.text: Portico mengembalikannya ke disk sendiri, sedikit demi sedikit.
server.places.reclaimHelp.source: Portico gives it back to the disk by itself, a little at a time.

server.places.upgradeCopiesNone.text: Tidak ada. Portico menyimpan salinan database sebelum mengubahnya untuk versi baru.
server.places.upgradeCopiesNone.source: None. Portico keeps a copy of the database before it changes it for a new version.

server.plays.empty.text: Belum ada yang diputar di server ini.
server.plays.empty.source: Nothing has been played on this server yet.

server.plays.emptyFiltered.text: Tidak ada pemutaran yang cocok dengan filter ini.

server.reports.deleteBody.text: Laporan dihapus dari server ini. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
server.reports.deleteBody.source: The report is removed from this server. This cannot be undone.

server.reports.lede.text: Log yang dikirim aplikasi setelah terjadi masalah. Log dapat menyebut judul dan perangkat, jadi hapus setelah selesai.
server.reports.lede.source: Logs an app sent after something went wrong. They can name titles and devices, so delete them when you are done.

server.restart.body.text: Apa pun yang diputar berhenti, dan aplikasi tersambung ulang sendiri setelah server kembali, biasanya dalam satu menit.
server.restart.body.source: Anything playing stops, and apps reconnect by themselves once the server is back, usually within a minute.

server.restart.failed.text: Server tidak dapat dimulai ulang. Coba lagi.
server.restart.failed.source: The server could not be restarted. Try again.

server.restart.waiting.source: Waiting for the server to come back

server.routes.forgetFor.source: Forget the playback problems of this file

server.routes.forgotten.text: Terlupakan. Portico akan mencoba cara itu lagi.
server.routes.forgotten.source: Forgotten. Portico will try that way again.

server.routes.lede.text: Saat perangkat tidak dapat memutar berkas dengan satu cara, Portico memutarnya dengan cara lain untuk sementara bukan gagal lagi. Lupakan satu agar cara pertama dicoba.
server.routes.lede.source: When a device can’t play a file one way, Portico plays it another way for a while instead of failing again. Forget one to let the first way be tried.

server.routes.route.copy_remux.source: Repackaging the file without converting it

server.routes.unknownTitle.text: Berkas tidak lagi ada di pustaka
server.routes.unknownTitle.source: A file no longer in a library

server.scan.depthHelp.basic.text: Baca detail berkas (durasi, resolusi, audio) dan artwork lokal.
server.scan.depthHelp.basic.source: Read file details (length, resolution, audio) and local artwork.

server.scan.depthHelp.complete.text: Semuanya, termasuk pratinjau, kenyaringan, dan sidik jari.
server.scan.depthHelp.complete.source: Everything, including previews, loudness and fingerprints.

server.scan.depthHelp.custom.text: Pilih tepat langkah mana yang berjalan.

server.scan.depthHelp.file_list_only.text: Hanya temukan berkas. Tanpa detail berkas atau artwork.
server.scan.depthHelp.file_list_only.source: Just find files. No file details or artwork.

server.scan.skippedHelp.text: Berkas dan folder yang dilewati pemindaian, masing-masing beserta alasannya. Sisanya dipindai seperti biasa.
server.scan.skippedHelp.source: Files and folders the scan left out, each with why. Everything else was scanned as usual.

server.scan.skippedNone.text: Pemindaian ini tidak melewati apa pun.

server.setAside.lede.text: Portico tidak dapat menyelesaikan pengolahan judul ini, sehingga menyisihkannya dan melanjutkan dengan sisanya. Portico mencobanya lagi sendiri.
server.setAside.lede.source: Portico could not finish working out these titles, so it set them aside and carried on with the rest. It tries them again by itself.

server.setAside.more.text: Lebih banyak yang disisihkan daripada yang tercantum di sini.
server.setAside.more.source: More are set aside than are listed here.

server.setAside.tried.text: {count, plural, one {Dicoba # kali} other {Dicoba # kali}}, terakhir pada {when}.
server.setAside.tried.source: {count, plural, one {Tried # time} other {Tried # times}}, last on {when}.

server.startup.instance.text: Hentikan layanan Portico lain yang memakai folder status ini, lalu mulai ulang layanan ini.
server.startup.instance.source: Stop the other Portico service using this state folder, then restart this service.

server.startup.permissions.text: Beri akun layanan izin membaca dan menulis folder status, lalu mulai ulang Portico.
server.startup.permissions.source: Give the service account permission to read and write the state folder, then restart Portico.

server.startup.phase.text: Server tidak dapat menyelesaikan pemeriksaan awalnya.
server.startup.phase.source: The server could not finish its startup checks.

server.startup.recovery.text: Periksa log layanan untuk detailnya. Perbaiki penyebabnya, lalu mulai ulang Portico. Berkas Anda tidak dihapus.
server.startup.recovery.source: Check the service log for details. Fix the cause, then restart Portico. Your files have not been removed.

server.startup.space.text: Kosongkan ruang di drive yang menampung folder status, lalu mulai ulang Portico.
server.startup.space.source: Free space on the drive holding the state folder, then restart Portico.

server.startup.storage.text: Periksa bahwa folder status tersedia, memiliki ruang bebas, dan dapat dibaca dan ditulis oleh layanan.
server.startup.storage.source: Check that the state folder is available, has free space, and can be read and written by the service.

server.startup.version.text: Database ini tidak cocok dengan Portico versi ini. Simpan salinan folder status, lalu pulihkan cadangan yang dibuat dengan versi ini atau mulai dengan folder status baru.
server.startup.version.source: This database does not match this Portico version. Keep a copy of the state folder, then restore a backup made with this version or start with a new state folder.

server.updates.checkHelp.text: Server mencari versi yang lebih baru dan memberi tahu Anda di sini. Portico tidak pernah memasang pembaruan sendiri.
server.updates.checkHelp.source: The server looks for a newer version and tells you here. Portico never installs an update by itself.

server.usage.connectionsHelp.text: {reserve} lagi selalu disimpan untuk konsol ini dan untuk masuk.
server.usage.connectionsHelp.source: Another {reserve} are always kept for this console and for signing in.

server.usage.lede.text: Yang dipakai server saat ini, di samping batas yang dapat Anda atur.
server.usage.lede.source: What the server is using at the moment, beside the limits you can set.

servers.connectDirect.source: Sign in directly to a server

settings.help.audioLanguages.text: Portico memilih yang pertama dari ini yang dimiliki judul. Jika tidak ada yang dipilih, judul diputar dengan trek aslinya.
settings.help.audioLanguages.source: Portico picks the first of these a title has. With none chosen, it plays the title’s original track.

settings.help.backdrops.text: Artwork di balik halaman judul dan Beranda.
settings.help.backdrops.source: Artwork behind title pages and Home.

settings.help.disableHdr.text: Nyalakan jika judul HDR terlihat abu-abu, pudar, atau terlalu gelap.
settings.help.disableHdr.source: Turn this on if HDR titles look grey, washed out or too dark.

settings.help.disablePassthrough.text: Nyalakan jika judul Dolby atau DTS diputar tanpa suara.
settings.help.disablePassthrough.source: Turn this on if Dolby or DTS titles play without sound.

settings.help.forceStereo.text: Nyalakan jika suara surround sunyi atau suara hilang.
settings.help.forceStereo.source: Turn this on if surround sound is silent or voices are missing.

settings.help.gapless.text: Tanpa hening antar lagu yang bersambung.
settings.help.gapless.source: No silence between songs that run into each other.

settings.help.layout.text: Televisi: fokus kendali jarak jauh dan huruf besar. Sentuh: layar ponsel dan tablet. Portico dimulai ulang untuk mengubahnya.
settings.help.layout.source: Television: remote-control focus and large type. Touch: phone and tablet screens. Portico restarts to change it.

settings.help.libraryView.text: Pustaka yang telah Anda alihkan menyimpan tampilannya sendiri.
settings.help.libraryView.source: A library you have switched keeps its own view.

settings.help.lyrics.text: Ikuti sesuai waktu dengan lagu saat lagu memiliki lirik.
settings.help.lyrics.source: Follow along in time with the song when it has lyrics.

settings.help.playbackMethod.text: Otomatis memutar berkas asli saat perangkat ini bisa, dan mengonversinya saat tidak bisa.
settings.help.playbackMethod.source: Automatic plays the original file when this device can, and converts it when it can’t.

settings.help.player.text: Otomatis memakai pemutar milik perangkat ini saat dapat memutar judul apa adanya, dan mpv saat judul seharusnya dikonversi atau subtitelnya dibakar.
settings.help.player.source: Automatic uses this device’s own player when it can play a title as it is, and mpv when the title would otherwise have to be converted or have its subtitles burned in.

settings.help.qualityAway.text: Di jaringan lain mana pun. Otomatis mulai dengan yang asli, menurunkan kualitas hanya saat koneksi Anda membutuhkannya, dan menaikkannya lagi saat memungkinkan.
settings.help.qualityAway.source: On any other network. Automatic starts with the original, lowers the quality only while your connection needs it, and raises it again when it can.

settings.help.qualityHome.text: Saat perangkat ini berada di jaringan rumah server Anda. Asli memutar setiap berkas apa adanya; Otomatis mulai dari sana dan menyesuaikan dengan koneksi Anda. Anda dapat memilih kualitas lain untuk satu tontonan di pemutar.
settings.help.qualityHome.source: When this device is on your server’s home network. Original plays every file as it is; Automatic starts there and adjusts to your connection. You can pick another quality for one viewing in the player.

settings.help.receiveFromDevices.text: Memungkinkan ponsel atau komputer Anda memulai pemutaran di TV ini.
settings.help.receiveFromDevices.source: Lets your phone or computer start playback on this TV.

settings.help.reduceMotionDevice.text: Transisi lebih singkat. Portico juga mengikuti pengaturan Kurangi Gerakan perangkat ini.
settings.help.reduceMotionDevice.source: Shorter transitions. Portico also follows the Reduce Motion setting of this device.

settings.help.showActivity.text: Memungkinkan orang lain di server ini melihat yang Anda tonton, dan menghitungnya di “Populer di server ini”.
settings.help.showActivity.source: Lets others on this server see what you’re watching, and counts it in “Popular on this server”.

settings.help.stillWatching.text: Jeda setelah beberapa episode beruntun saat tidak ada yang menyentuh kontrol.
settings.help.stillWatching.source: Pauses after several episodes in a row when no one has touched the controls.

settings.help.subtitleLanguages.text: Portico memilih yang pertama dari ini yang dimiliki judul.
settings.help.subtitleLanguages.source: Portico picks the first of these a title has.

settings.help.subtitleMode.text: Subtitel wajib hanya menerjemahkan baris yang diucapkan dalam bahasa lain.
settings.help.subtitleMode.source: Forced subtitles translate only the lines spoken in another language.

settings.help.tvHdr.text: Nyalakan jika TV Anda menampilkan HDR. Judul HDR lalu dikirim apa adanya bukan dikonversi ke rentang standar.
settings.help.tvHdr.source: Turn on if your TV shows HDR. HDR titles are then sent as they are instead of being converted to standard range.

settings.help.tvSurround.text: Nyalakan jika TV Anda, atau sistem suara yang tersambung, memutar suara 5.1 atau 7.1. Surround lalu dipertahankan bukan dicampur ke stereo.
settings.help.tvSurround.source: Turn on if your TV, or a sound system connected to it, plays 5.1 or 7.1 sound. Surround is then kept instead of being mixed down to stereo.

settings.help.volumeLeveling.text: Memutar lagu atau album pada kenyaringan serupa.
settings.help.volumeLeveling.source: Plays songs or albums at a similar loudness.

settings.layout.restart.text: Portico dimulai ulang untuk memakai tata letak baru.
settings.layout.restart.source: Portico restarts to use the new layout.

settings.linkTVHelp.text: Masukkan TV dengan kode yang ditampilkannya
settings.linkTVHelp.source: Sign a TV in with the code it shows

settings.notSaved.text: Perubahan itu tidak tersimpan. Coba lagi.
settings.notSaved.source: That change wasn’t saved. Try again.

settings.openOnWeb.text: Pindai kode dengan ponsel Anda, atau buka {url} di komputer.
settings.openOnWeb.source: Scan the code with your phone, or go to {url} on a computer.

settings.resetRecommendations.confirmBod.text: Portico akan melupakan apa yang dipelajarinya tentang selera Anda. Riwayat tontonan, rating, dan daftar Anda tetap ada.
settings.resetRecommendations.confirmBod.source: Portico will forget what it has learned about your taste. Your watch history, ratings and lists stay.

settings.resetRecommendations.failed.text: Rekomendasi tidak dapat diatur ulang. Coba lagi.
settings.resetRecommendations.failed.source: Recommendations couldn’t be reset. Try again.

settings.resetRecommendations.help.text: Mulai dari awal dengan rekomendasi Portico untuk Anda.
settings.resetRecommendations.help.source: Start over with what Portico recommends to you.

settings.row.disablePassthrough.text: Jangan kirim suara ke receiver saya tanpa diolah
settings.row.disablePassthrough.source: Don’t send sound to my receiver untouched

settings.row.startNextDuringCredits.source: Start the next episode during the credits

settings.row.unreadBadge.source: Show a dot for new notifications

settings.save.afterRestart.source: Takes effect after the server restarts

settings.search.none.text: Tidak ada pengaturan yang cocok dengan “{query}”.

settings.section.playbackFixes.text: Jika ada yang terlihat atau terdengar salah
settings.section.playbackFixes.source: If something looks or sounds wrong

settings.section.playbackFixesHelp.text: Biarkan mati kecuali judul diputar buruk di perangkat ini.
settings.section.playbackFixesHelp.source: Leave these off unless a title plays badly on this device.

settings.section.tvOutputs.text: Yang dapat ditampilkan dan diputar TV ini
settings.section.tvOutputs.source: What this TV can show and play

settings.section.tvOutputsHelp.text: Perangkat ini tidak dapat mengetahui yang didukung TV dan sistem suara Anda, sehingga Portico memutar semuanya dalam rentang standar dan stereo hingga Anda menyatakan lain.
settings.section.tvOutputsHelp.source: This device can’t tell what your TV and sound system support, so Portico plays everything in standard range and stereo until you say otherwise.

settings.server.accountCapHelp.text: Berlaku untuk setiap akun. Batas milik seseorang diatur di akunnya pada Orang.
settings.server.accountCapHelp.source: Applies to each account. A person’s own limit is set on their account in People.

settings.server.advertiseUrlHelp.text: Alamat yang dipakai orang di luar rumah Anda untuk menjangkau server ini, seperti https://media.example.com. Pakai nama host tanpa jalur setelahnya.
settings.server.advertiseUrlHelp.source: The address people outside your home use to reach this server, such as https://media.example.com. Use a hostname with no path after it.

settings.server.allowConverting.text: Konversi video yang tidak dapat diputar perangkat
settings.server.allowConverting.source: Convert video a device can’t play

settings.server.apiRate.text: Permintaan yang boleh dibuat setiap kunci atau token
settings.server.apiRate.source: Requests each key or token may make

settings.server.apiRateHelp.text: Kunci atau token yang meminta lebih sering dari ini diminta menunggu. Orang yang memakai aplikasi tidak pernah diperlambat olehnya. Biarkan kosong untuk 600 per menit yang biasa.
settings.server.apiRateHelp.source: A key or token that asks more often than this is told to wait. People using the apps are never slowed by it. Leave empty for the usual 600 a minute.

settings.server.backgroundSpeedHelp.text: Seberapa keras Portico bekerja memindai, mencocokkan, menganalisis, artwork, dan pemeliharaan. Pelan cocok untuk server kecil. Cepat menyelesaikan impor besar lebih segera. Pemutaran selalu diutamakan.
settings.server.backgroundSpeedHelp.source: How hard Portico works at scanning, matching, analysis, artwork and maintenance. Gentle suits a small server. Fast finishes a large import sooner. Playback always comes first.

settings.server.connectionLimitHelp.text: Koneksi terbanyak yang diterima server sekaligus. Biarkan kosong dan server memilih dari memorinya. Konsol dan proses masuk selalu menyimpan ruang sendiri. Perubahan berlaku setelah server dimulai ulang.
settings.server.connectionLimitHelp.source: The most connections the server accepts at once. Leave empty and the server chooses from its memory. The console and sign-in always keep room of their own. A change takes effect after the server restarts.

settings.server.conversionsBackground.text: Untuk unduhan dan versi yang disiapkan

settings.server.conversionsBackgroundHel.text: Konversi yang tidak ditonton siapa pun. Konversi tidak pernah mengambil slot dari yang menonton.
settings.server.conversionsBackgroundHel.source: Conversions nobody is watching. They never take a slot from someone who is.

settings.server.conversionsHelp.text: Stream lanjutan yang perlu dikonversi menunggu atau diputar pada kualitas lebih rendah.
settings.server.conversionsHelp.source: Further streams that need converting wait or play at a lower quality.

settings.server.detailWindow.text: Rekam lebih banyak detail selama 30 menit

settings.server.detailWindow.help.text: Menyalakan pesan detail, lalu mematikannya sendiri.
settings.server.detailWindow.help.source: Turns on detailed messages, then turns itself off.

settings.server.discoveryHelp.text: Memungkinkan aplikasi di jaringan Anda menemukan server tanpa mengetik alamat.
settings.server.discoveryHelp.source: Lets apps on your network find the server without typing an address.

settings.server.encoderSpeedHelp.text: Lebih cepat memakai lebih sedikit prosesor dan memberi gambar sedikit lebih lembut pada ukuran yang sama.
settings.server.encoderSpeedHelp.source: Faster uses less processor and gives a slightly softer picture at the same size.

settings.server.extraAddressesHelp.text: Lebih banyak alamat yang boleh dicoba aplikasi, seperti nama VPN. Aplikasi menguji masing-masing sendiri.
settings.server.extraAddressesHelp.source: More addresses apps may try, such as a VPN name. Apps test each one themselves.

settings.server.ffmpegChosenHelp.text: Biarkan kosong untuk memakai FFmpeg yang disertakan Portico. Untuk memakai build lain, berikan jalur lengkapnya. Portico memeriksanya saat Anda menyimpan dan mulai memakainya setelah server dimulai ulang.
settings.server.ffmpegChosenHelp.source: Leave empty to use the FFmpeg that comes with Portico. To use another build, give its full path. Portico checks it when you save and starts using it after the server restarts.

settings.server.hardwareDeviceHelp.text: Biarkan kosong agar server memilih. Di Linux, jalur perangkat render.
settings.server.hardwareDeviceHelp.source: Leave empty to let the server choose. On Linux, a render device path.

settings.server.hardwareHelp.text: Otomatis memakai perangkat keras grafis yang dimiliki server ini, dan kembali ke prosesor.
settings.server.hardwareHelp.source: Automatic uses the graphics hardware this server has, and falls back to the processor.

settings.server.homeNetworkLede.text: Jaringan ini menentukan yang dihitung sebagai rumah. Perangkat di tempat lain berarti jauh dari rumah, dan aturan serta batas jauh-dari-rumah berlaku untuknya.
settings.server.homeNetworkLede.source: These networks decide what counts as home. A device anywhere else is away from home, and the away-from-home rules and limits apply to it.

settings.server.homeNetworksHelp.text: Alamat atau rentang, seperti 192.168.2.0/24. Daftar dimulai dengan rentang privat yang biasa dan jaringan yang terpasang ke server ini. Tambahkan rentang VPN jika harus dihitung sebagai rumah. Dengan daftar kosong, setiap perangkat berarti jauh dari rumah.
settings.server.homeNetworksHelp.source: An address or a range, such as 192.168.2.0/24. The list starts with the usual private ranges and the networks this server is attached to. Add a VPN range if it should count as home. With an empty list, every device is away from home.

settings.server.jobs.never.text: Tidak dijadwalkan: tidak ada jendela aktif yang mencakupnya
settings.server.jobs.never.source: Not scheduled: no enabled window includes it

settings.server.keep.prepared.text: Simpan media siap pakai yang tak terpakai selama

settings.server.memberTokensMay.source: Members may make their own tokens

settings.server.memberTokensMayHelp.text: Memilih Tidak menghentikan token baru. Token yang sudah ada tetap berfungsi hingga Anda mengakhirinya.
settings.server.memberTokensMayHelp.source: Choosing No stops new tokens. Tokens that already exist keep working until you end them.

settings.server.missingTitlesLede.text: Judul yang berkasnya tidak lagi ada di disk tetap ada di pustaka, ditandai hilang. Jika berkas kembali, judul pun kembali, dengan semua seperti semula.
settings.server.missingTitlesLede.source: A title whose files are no longer on disk stays in the library, marked missing. If the files come back, so does the title, with everything as it was.

settings.server.missingTitlesRuleHelp.text: Riwayat tontonan tetap disimpan, dan kembali jika judul ditambahkan lagi.
settings.server.missingTitlesRuleHelp.source: Watch history is kept either way, and returns if a title is added again.

settings.server.ownCertificateLede.text: Untuk domain Anda sendiri tanpa proksi balik: berkas sertifikat dan kunci di server ini, dalam bentuk PEM, dan domain yang dicakupnya. Server mengambil berkas yang diperbarui sendiri.
settings.server.ownCertificateLede.source: For your own domain without a reverse proxy: the certificate and key files on this server, in PEM form, and the domain they cover. The server picks up renewed files by itself.

settings.server.pauseBackground.text: Jeda kerja latar belakang selama sejam
settings.server.pauseBackground.source: Pause background work for an hour

settings.server.planning.text: Saat perangkat tidak dapat memutar berkas
settings.server.planning.source: When a device can’t play a file

settings.server.planning.maximum_compati.source: Play on as many devices as possible

settings.server.planning.minimize_server.text: Lakukan kerja paling sedikit di server
settings.server.planning.minimize_server.source: Do the least work on the server

settings.server.planningHelp.text: Yang diutamakan server saat memilih cara mengirim judul.
settings.server.planningHelp.source: What the server favors when it chooses how to deliver a title.

settings.server.playHistoryKeepHelp.text: Setiap pemutaran disimpan kecuali Anda menetapkan jumlah hari. Jumlah pemutaran tetap disimpan.
settings.server.playHistoryKeepHelp.source: Every play is kept unless you set a number of days. Play counts are kept either way.

settings.server.qualityLimitHelp.text: Bitrate tertinggi bagi siapa pun di luar jaringan rumah Anda.
settings.server.qualityLimitHelp.source: Highest bitrate for anyone outside your home network.

settings.server.records.none.text: Belum ada yang direkam di sini.

settings.server.remote.notSetUp.text: Akses jarak jauh belum disiapkan di server ini.
settings.server.remote.notSetUp.source: Remote access is not set up on this server.

settings.server.remote.off.text: Akses jarak jauh mati. Perangkat di jaringan rumah Anda tersambung seperti biasa.
settings.server.remote.off.source: Remote access is off. Devices on your home network connect as usual.

settings.server.repackage.text: Kemas ulang bukan mengonversi bila itu cukup
settings.server.repackage.source: Repackage instead of converting when that is enough

settings.server.repackageHelp.text: Hanya mengubah kontainer berkas dan mempertahankan gambar serta suara apa adanya.
settings.server.repackageHelp.source: Changes only the file’s container and keeps the picture and sound as they are.

settings.server.retentionLede.text: Berapa lama rekaman, berkas yang dibuat, dan cadangan disimpan sebelum server menghapusnya.
settings.server.retentionLede.source: How long records, generated files and backups stay before the server removes them.

settings.server.secure.connectHelp.text: Membuka Portico Account Anda di jendela baru, tempat Anda menyetujui server ini. Hanya itu: sertifikat menyusul sendiri.
settings.server.secure.connectHelp.source: Opens your Portico Account in a new window, where you approve this server. That’s all: the certificate follows by itself.

settings.server.secure.connectInBrowserH.text: Membuka pengaturan server ini di browser Anda, tempat Anda menyetujuinya di Portico Account Anda. Atau masuk ke Portico Account Anda di aplikasi ini untuk melakukannya di sini.
settings.server.secure.connectInBrowserH.source: Opens this server’s settings in your browser, where you approve it in your Portico Account. Or sign in to your Portico Account in this app to do it here.

settings.server.secure.connectWithAccoun.text: Menyambungkan server ini ke Portico Account Anda dan memperoleh sertifikatnya. Tidak ada lagi yang perlu dilakukan.
settings.server.secure.connectWithAccoun.source: Connects this server to your Portico Account and gets its certificate. Nothing else to do.

settings.server.secure.connected.source: Connected. Portico is getting the certificate now.

settings.server.secure.lede.text: Mengenkripsi semua antara perangkat Anda dan server ini, di rumah maupun jauh, dengan sertifikat yang dipercaya setiap browser dan aplikasi. Portico memperoleh dan memperbaruinya untuk Anda.
settings.server.secure.lede.source: Encrypts everything between your devices and this server, at home and away, with a certificate every browser and app trusts. Portico gets it and renews it for you.

settings.server.secure.notSetUp.text: Perangkat tersambung dengan HTTP polos. Untuk menyalakan koneksi aman, sambungkan server ini ke Portico Account Anda: Portico lalu memperoleh dan memperbarui sertifikat sendiri. Atau pakai sertifikat Anda sendiri, di bawah.
settings.server.secure.notSetUp.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. To turn on a secure connection, connect this server to your Portico Account: Portico then gets and renews a certificate by itself. Or use your own certificate, below.

settings.server.secure.notSetUpOwnOnly.text: Perangkat tersambung dengan HTTP polos. Untuk menyalakan koneksi aman, pakai sertifikat Anda sendiri, di bawah.
settings.server.secure.notSetUpOwnOnly.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. To turn on a secure connection, use your own certificate, below.

settings.server.secure.off.text: Perangkat tersambung dengan HTTP polos. Nyalakan “Pakai koneksi aman” untuk mengenkripsi lagi koneksinya.
settings.server.secure.off.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. Turn on “Use a secure connection” to encrypt their connection again.

settings.server.secure.on.text: Perangkat tersambung ke server ini dengan aman, di rumah maupun jauh.
settings.server.secure.on.source: Devices connect to this server securely, at home and away.

settings.server.secure.onAt.text: Perangkat tersambung ke server ini dengan aman, di rumah maupun jauh. Alamat amannya adalah {address}.
settings.server.secure.onAt.source: Devices connect to this server securely, at home and away. Its secure address is {address}.

settings.server.secure.own.text: Perangkat tersambung aman dengan sertifikat Anda sendiri.
settings.server.secure.own.source: Devices connect securely with your own certificate.

settings.server.secure.ownAt.text: Perangkat tersambung aman ke {address} dengan sertifikat Anda sendiri.
settings.server.secure.ownAt.source: Devices connect securely to {address} with your own certificate.

settings.server.secure.portHelp.text: Port yang dipakai perangkat untuk alamat aman dari luar rumah Anda.
settings.server.secure.portHelp.source: The port devices use for the secure address from outside your home.

settings.server.secure.starting.text: Portico sedang memperoleh sertifikat untuk server ini. Biasanya perlu satu atau dua menit; tidak ada yang perlu dilakukan sementara itu.
settings.server.secure.starting.source: Portico is getting a certificate for this server. This usually takes a minute or two; nothing needs doing meanwhile.

settings.server.secure.toggleHelp.text: Saat ini mati, perangkat tersambung dengan HTTP polos. Perangkat tetap berfungsi; hanya koneksinya tidak terenkripsi.
settings.server.secure.toggleHelp.source: When this is off, devices connect with plain HTTP. They still work; their connection just isn’t encrypted.

settings.server.secure.waiting.text: Setujui server ini di Portico Account Anda untuk menyelesaikan. Sertifikat menyusul sendiri.
settings.server.secure.waiting.source: Approve this server in your Portico Account to finish. The certificate follows by itself.

settings.server.sessionSpaceHelp.text: Berapa banyak disk yang boleh dipakai stream yang dikonversi untuk berkas kerjanya. Saat tercapai, bagian yang sudah diputar dihapus terlebih dahulu.
settings.server.sessionSpaceHelp.source: How much disk a stream being converted may use for its working files. When it is reached, the parts already played are removed first.

settings.server.skippedParts.text: Bagian yang tidak dapat dibaca aplikasi ini
settings.server.skippedParts.source: Parts this app could not read

settings.server.skippedPartsCount.source: {count, plural, one {# left out} other {# left out}}

settings.server.skippedPartsLede.text: Saat server mengirim sesuatu yang tidak dipahami aplikasi ini, biasanya karena server lebih baru, aplikasi melewatkan bagian itu dan menampilkan sisanya. Ini mencantumkan yang dilewati di perangkat ini sejak aplikasi dimulai.
settings.server.skippedPartsLede.source: When the server sends something this app does not understand, usually because the server is newer, the app leaves that part out and shows the rest. This lists what was left out on this device since the app started.

settings.server.tempFolderHelp.text: Tempat server menulis video saat mengonversinya. Biarkan kosong untuk folder tembolok miliknya.
settings.server.tempFolderHelp.source: Where the server writes video while converting it. Leave empty for its own cache folder.

settings.server.toneMappingHelp.text: Menjaga warna tetap tepat saat video HDR dikonversi untuk layar tanpa HDR.
settings.server.toneMappingHelp.source: Keeps colors right when HDR video is converted for a screen without HDR.

settings.server.trustedProxiesHelp.text: Alamat proksi balik di depan server ini, seperti 127.0.0.1. Server memercayai alamat penonton yang diteruskan proksi tercantum. Biarkan kosong jika Anda tidak memakainya.
settings.server.trustedProxiesHelp.source: The address of a reverse proxy in front of this server, such as 127.0.0.1. The server believes the viewer address a listed proxy passes on. Leave empty if you don’t use one.

settings.server.uploadSpeedHelp.text: Kecepatan unggah internet rumah Anda. Stream yang jauh dari rumah berbagi sekitar 80% darinya, dan stream baru diputar pada kualitas lebih rendah saat sibuk.
settings.server.uploadSpeedHelp.source: Your home internet upload speed. Streams away from home share about 80% of it, and a new stream plays at a lower quality when it’s busy.

settings.server.windowsLede.text: Saat pencadangan terjadwal berjalan. Pekerjaan latar belakang lain mengikuti pilihan kecepatan Anda. Waktu memakai waktu server sendiri.
settings.server.windowsLede.source: When scheduled backups run. Other background work follows your speed choice. Times are the server’s own.

settings.signOutConfirm.bodyDownloads.text: Unduhan tetap ada di perangkat ini.

settings.signOutConfirm.bodyRemoving.text: Unduhan Anda dihapus dari perangkat ini. Semua yang Anda unduh tetap ada di server Anda.
settings.signOutConfirm.bodyRemoving.source: Your downloads are removed from this device. Anything you downloaded stays on your server.

settings.signOutConfirm.bodyTV.text: Anda perlu memasukkan TV ini lagi.
settings.signOutConfirm.bodyTV.source: You’ll need to sign this TV in again.

settings.signOutConfirm.removeDownloads.text: Hapus unduhan saya dari perangkat ini
settings.signOutConfirm.removeDownloads.source: Remove my downloads from this device

settings.signedInWithAccount.text: Masuk ke {server} dengan Portico Account Anda
settings.signedInWithAccount.source: Signed in to {server} with your Portico Account

settings.subtitlePreview.line.source: This is how subtitles will look.

setup.app.connectLede.text: Portico Account Anda terbuka di browser. Masuk di sana jika perlu, setujui server ini, lalu kembali ke sini.
