setup.app.connectLede.source: Your Portico Account opens in the browser. Sign in there if you need to, approve this server, then come back here.

setup.app.found.text: Server ini belum disiapkan siapa pun. Anda dapat menyiapkannya dari sini.
setup.app.found.source: Nobody has set up this server yet. You can set it up from here.

setup.app.nextWithAccount.text: Berikutnya, server ini bergabung dengan {account} dan memperoleh koneksi amannya sendiri.
setup.app.nextWithAccount.source: Next, this server joins {account} and gets its secure connection by itself.

setup.app.notSetUp.text: Server ini belum disiapkan. Siapkan dari aplikasi Portico di ponsel atau tablet, atau buka alamatnya di browser.
setup.app.notSetUp.source: This server isn’t set up yet. Set it up from the Portico app on a phone or tablet, or open its address in a browser.

shell.titleNotOnProfile.text: Judul itu tidak lagi tersedia di profil ini.
shell.titleNotOnProfile.source: That title isn’t available on this profile anymore.

signIn.chooseLocalProfile.text: Pilih profil di server ini untuk melanjutkan.
signIn.chooseLocalProfile.source: Choose a profile on this server to continue.

signIn.cleanupSignedOut.text: Anda sudah keluar. Portico tidak dapat mengonfirmasi bahwa data masuk yang tersimpan telah dihapus dari perangkat ini.
signIn.cleanupSignedOut.source: You’re signed out. Portico couldn’t confirm that the saved sign-in was removed from this device.

signIn.cleanupUnconfirmed.text: Portico tidak dapat mengonfirmasi bahwa data masuk yang tersimpan telah dihapus.
signIn.cleanupUnconfirmed.source: Portico couldn’t confirm that the saved sign-in was removed.

signIn.error.codeInvalid.text: Kode itu tidak berfungsi. Periksa dan coba lagi.
signIn.error.codeInvalid.source: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.

signIn.error.detailsRequired.source: Enter your details to sign in.

signIn.error.expired.source: That took too long. Start again.

signIn.error.notAccepted.text: Data masuk itu tidak diterima. Periksa detail Anda dan coba lagi.
signIn.error.notAccepted.source: That sign-in wasn’t accepted. Check your details and try again.

signIn.error.pinInvalid.text: PIN itu tidak tepat. Coba lagi.
signIn.error.pinInvalid.source: That PIN isn’t right. Try again.

signIn.error.tooManyTries.text: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Tunggu sebentar, lalu coba lagi.
signIn.error.tooManyTries.source: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.

signIn.plainHttp.owner.text: Pemilik server dapat menyalakan koneksi aman di Pengaturan › Akses jarak jauh.
signIn.plainHttp.owner.source: The server’s owner can turn on a secure connection in Settings › Remote access.

signIn.reset.body.text: Atur ulang perangkat ini untuk masuk lagi.
signIn.reset.body.source: Reset this device to sign in again.

signIn.reset.consequence.text: Semua orang keluar dari Portico di perangkat ini, dan server serta pengaturan yang diingatnya dilupakan. Unduhan tetap ada. Tidak ada yang berubah di server Anda.
signIn.reset.consequence.source: Everyone is signed out of Portico on this device, and the servers and settings it remembers are forgotten. Downloads stay. Nothing on your server changes.

signIn.reset.failed.text: Perangkat ini tidak dapat diatur ulang. Coba lagi, atau hapus penyimpanan Portico di pengaturan perangkat ini.
signIn.reset.failed.source: This device couldn’t be reset. Try again, or clear Portico’s storage in this device’s settings.

signIn.reset.reopen.text: Tutup Portico dan buka lagi untuk menyelesaikan.
signIn.reset.reopen.source: Close Portico and open it again to finish.

signIn.reset.title.text: Perangkat ini tidak dapat membaca data masuk yang tersimpan
signIn.reset.title.source: This device can’t read its saved sign-in

signIn.savedUnreadable.text: Perangkat ini tidak dapat membaca data masuk yang tersimpan. Masuk lagi.
signIn.savedUnreadable.source: This device couldn’t read its saved sign-in. Sign in again.

signIn.unusedSession.text: Portico tidak dapat mengakhiri data masuk yang tidak digunakan. Data itu akan kedaluwarsa dengan sendirinya.
signIn.unusedSession.source: Portico couldn’t end an unused sign-in. It will expire on its own.

subtitles.error.changed.text: Subtitel berubah. Muat ulang dan periksa revisi saat ini sebelum mencoba lagi.
subtitles.error.changed.source: Subtitles changed. Refresh and review the current revision before retrying.

subtitles.error.denied.text: Anda tidak lagi memiliki akses ke subtitel ini.
subtitles.error.denied.source: You no longer have access to these subtitles.

subtitles.error.failed.text: Subtitel tidak dapat diperbarui. Muat ulang, atau ulangi operasi yang sama.
subtitles.error.failed.source: Subtitles could not be updated. Refresh, or retry the same operation.

subtitles.error.invalidInput.text: Periksa bahasa, berkas, dan pengaturan waktu. Gunakan SRT/WebVTT polos atau subtitel kaya/bitmap yang didukung dalam batas ukuran dan isyarat.
subtitles.error.invalidInput.source: Check the language, file and timing. Use plain SRT/WebVTT or supported rich/bitmap subtitles within the size and cue limits.

subtitles.error.missing.text: Subtitel ini tidak lagi tersedia. Muat ulang pilihan saat ini.
subtitles.error.missing.source: This subtitle is no longer available. Refresh the current choices.

title.changedElsewhere.text: Judul ini diubah di perangkat lain. Pilihan terbaru Anda disimpan.
title.changedElsewhere.source: This title was changed on another device. Your latest choice is kept.

title.collectionEmpty.text: Belum ada apa pun di koleksi ini

title.deleteVersion.body.text: Satu berkas ini ({size}) dihapus dari disk sekaligus dan tidak dapat dipulihkan. Judul, versi lainnya, dan riwayat tontonan semua orang tetap ada. Jika ini satu-satunya versi, judul tetap ada di pustaka dengan tanda hilang.
title.deleteVersion.body.source: This one file ({size}) is deleted from disk at once and can’t be recovered. The title, its other versions and everyone’s watch history stay. If it is the only version, the title stays in the library marked missing.

title.fileUnavailable.text: Berkas judul ini tidak tersedia saat ini.
title.fileUnavailable.source: This title’s file isn’t available right now.

title.finishedCount.text: {finished, plural, one {# selesai} other {# selesai}} · {remaining, plural, one {# tersisa} other {# tersisa}}
title.finishedCount.source: {finished, plural, one {# finished} other {# finished}} · {remaining, plural, one {# remaining} other {# remaining}}

title.kind.text: {kind, select, movie {Film} show {Acara TV} anime {Anime} season {Musim} episode {Episode} song {Lagu} album {Album} artist {Artis} audiobook_file {Buku audio} book {Buku audio} collection {Koleksi} category {Kategori} author {Penulis} book_series {Seri buku} disc {Cakram} playlist {Playlist} person {Orang} other {Judul}}
title.kind.source: {kind, select, movie {Movie} show {TV show} anime {Anime} season {Season} episode {Episode} song {Song} album {Album} artist {Artist} audiobook_file {Audiobook} book {Audiobook} collection {Collection} category {Category} author {Author} book_series {Book series} disc {Disc} playlist {Playlist} person {Person} other {Title}}

title.merge.none.text: Tidak ada judul lain yang cocok.

title.missingSince.text: Berkasnya tidak ada di disk sejak {when}. Judul kembali dengan sendirinya, dengan semua seperti semula, saat berkas kembali.
title.missingSince.source: Its files have not been on disk since {when}. It comes back by itself, with everything as it was, when they return.

title.noCreditsBody.text: Belum ada apa pun di server ini yang mengkredit orang ini.
title.noCreditsBody.source: Nothing on this server credits this person yet.

title.noEpisodesBody.text: Musim ini belum memiliki episode di server.
title.noEpisodesBody.source: This season has no episodes on the server yet.

title.noRoleCredits.text: {role, select, cast {Tidak ada kredit pemeran di server ini.} crew {Tidak ada kredit kru di server ini.} other {Tidak ada kredit di server ini.}}
title.noRoleCredits.source: {role, select, cast {No cast credits on this server.} crew {No crew credits on this server.} other {No credits on this server.}}

title.nothingHere.text: Belum ada apa pun di sini

title.peopleFailed.text: Sisa pemeran dan kru tidak dapat dimuat.
title.peopleFailed.source: The rest of the cast and crew couldn’t be loaded.

title.playlistEmptyBody.text: Tekan dan tahan judul lalu pilih Tambahkan ke playlist.
title.playlistEmptyBody.source: Press and hold a title and choose Add to playlist.

title.playlistEmptyBodyTV.text: Tekan dan tahan Pilih pada judul lalu pilih Tambahkan ke playlist.
title.playlistEmptyBodyTV.source: Press and hold Select on a title and choose Add to playlist.

title.separateArtist.body.text: Untuk album oleh orang lain dengan nama yang sama. Album dan lagunya pindah ke artis baru dengan nama yang sama, dan Portico tidak akan menggabungkan keduanya lagi dengan sendirinya. Anda dapat mengganti nama artis baru, atau menggabungkannya lagi nanti. Tidak ada yang dihapus.
title.separateArtist.body.source: For an album by someone else with the same name. The album and its songs move to a new artist of the same name, and Portico won’t join the two again by itself. You can rename the new artist, or merge them again later. Nothing is deleted.

title.separateArtist.failed.text: Album tidak dapat dipindahkan. Satu-satunya album seorang artis tidak dapat dipisahkan darinya.
title.separateArtist.failed.source: The album could not be moved. An artist’s only album can’t be separated from it.

title.separateArtist.title.text: Pindahkan album ini ke artis tersendiri?
title.separateArtist.title.source: Move this album to an artist of its own?

title.showSettings.absoluteHelp.text: Episode terbaca “Episode 1043” bukan musim dan episode.
title.showSettings.absoluteHelp.source: Episodes read “Episode 1043” instead of a season and an episode.

title.showSettings.hideSeasonsHelp.text: Satu daftar episode lintas semua musim.
title.showSettings.hideSeasonsHelp.source: One list of episodes across every season.

title.showSettings.lede.text: Cara episode acara ini dicantumkan, untuk semua orang di server ini.
title.showSettings.lede.source: How this show’s episodes are listed, for everyone on this server.

title.showSettings.newestFirstHelp.text: Untuk acara harian: episode terbaru ada di atas.
title.showSettings.newestFirstHelp.source: For daily shows: the latest episode is at the top.

title.showSettings.rangesHelp.text: Untuk acara panjang: 1–100, 101–200, dan seterusnya, menggantikan musim.
title.showSettings.rangesHelp.source: For long shows: 1–100, 101–200 and so on, in place of seasons.

title.split.body.text: Untuk berkas yang dikelompokkan dengan judul yang salah. Berkas menjadi judul tersendiri dan dicocokkan lagi. Tidak ada yang dihapus, dan Portico mengingat pilihan saat memindai. Anda dapat menggabungkan keduanya lagi nanti.
title.split.body.source: For a file that was grouped with the wrong title. It becomes a title of its own and is matched again. Nothing is deleted, and Portico remembers the choice when it scans. You can merge the two again later.

title.split.failed.text: Versi tidak dapat dipisahkan. Coba lagi.
title.split.failed.source: The version could not be split off. Try again.

title.split.notFound.text: Portico tidak menemukan berkas ini dalam daftar pustaka. Pindai pustaka, lalu coba lagi.
title.split.notFound.source: Portico could not find this file in the library’s list. Scan the library, then try again.

title.split.title.source: Make this version a title of its own?

title.splitFolder.body.text: Untuk folder yang digabung dengan album atau buku yang salah. Setiap berkas dalam folder berkas ini pindah ke album atau buku tersendiri, dan Portico tidak akan menggabungkannya lagi dengan sendirinya. Tidak ada yang dihapus, dan Anda dapat menggabungkannya lagi nanti.
title.splitFolder.body.source: For a folder that was joined with the wrong album or book. Every file in this file’s folder moves to an album or book of its own, and Portico won’t join them again by itself. Nothing is deleted, and you can merge them again later.

title.splitFolder.failed.text: Folder tidak dapat dipisahkan. Coba lagi.
title.splitFolder.failed.source: The folder could not be separated. Try again.

title.splitFolder.title.source: Make this folder an album of its own?

title.splitFolder.titleBook.source: Make this folder a book of its own?

title.viewEmpty.text: Tidak ada yang cocok dengan tampilan ini saat ini
title.viewEmpty.source: Nothing matches this view right now

together.error.changed.text: Grup baru saja berubah. Coba lagi.
together.error.changed.source: The group changed just then. Try again.

together.error.memberCantSee.text: Ada anggota grup yang tidak dapat melihat judul ini di profilnya.
together.error.memberCantSee.source: Someone in the group can’t see this title on their profile.

together.error.notReached.text: Itu tidak sampai ke grup. Coba lagi.
together.error.notReached.source: That didn’t reach the group. Try again.

together.error.queueAdd.text: Itu tidak dapat ditambahkan ke antrean grup.
together.error.queueAdd.source: That couldn’t be added to the group’s queue.

together.error.unavailable.text: Server ini tidak menawarkan Nonton Bareng.
together.error.unavailable.source: This server doesn’t offer Watch Together.

together.hostOnly.move.text: Hanya host yang dapat memindahkan grup ke momen lain.
together.hostOnly.move.source: Only the host can move the group to another moment.

together.hostOnly.playPause.text: Hanya host yang dapat memutar dan menjeda untuk grup.
together.hostOnly.playPause.source: Only the host can play and pause for the group.

twoFactor.verifyFailed.text: Kode itu tidak berfungsi. Periksa dan coba lagi.
twoFactor.verifyFailed.source: That code didn’t work. Check it and try again.

vega.connection.credentialExposed.text: Koneksi ini mengirim detail masuk Anda ke alamat lain, sehingga Anda telah keluar.
vega.connection.credentialExposed.source: This connection sent your sign-in details to another address, so you have been signed out.

vega.connection.redirectLimit.text: Perangkat ini hanya dapat memeriksa pengalihan setelah permintaan dikirim.
vega.connection.redirectLimit.source: This device can check redirects only after a request has been sent.

watched.undoGone.text: Sudah terlambat untuk mengurungkannya. “{title}” tetap seperti yang Anda tandai.
watched.undoGone.source: It is too late to undo that. “{title}” stays as you marked it.

web.about.legal.text: Metadata dan artwork disediakan oleh TMDB dan penyedia lain yang dikonfigurasi di server Anda.
web.about.legal.source: Metadata and artwork are provided by TMDB and other providers configured on your server.

web.about.tmdb.text: Produk ini memakai TMDB API tetapi tidak didukung atau disertifikasi oleh TMDB.
web.about.tmdb.source: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

web.access.devicesLede.text: Setiap perangkat yang masuk ke server ini.
web.access.devicesLede.source: Every device that has signed in to this server.

web.access.devicesWaiting.text: {count, plural, one {# perangkat menunggu} other {# perangkat menunggu}} persetujuan Anda.
web.access.devicesWaiting.source: {count, plural, one {# device is} other {# devices are}} waiting for your approval.

web.access.emailHelp.text: Opsional — hanya dipakai untuk memberi label undangan.
web.access.emailHelp.source: Optional — only used to label the invitation.

web.access.invitationsLede.text: Buat tautan dan kode untuk dibagikan. Mereka bergabung dengan Portico Account mereka, atau membuat akun di server ini. Portico tidak mengirim email.
web.access.invitationsLede.source: Make a link and a code to share. They join with their Portico Account, or make an account on this server. Portico sends no email.

web.access.keyShownOnce.text: Ini satu-satunya saat kunci ditampilkan. Server menyimpan sidik jari, bukan kuncinya.
web.access.keyShownOnce.source: This is the only time the key is shown. The server keeps a fingerprint, not the key.

web.access.remoteQualityHelp.text: Bitrate tertinggi saat tidak di jaringan rumah Anda, dalam Mbps.
web.access.remoteQualityHelp.source: Highest bitrate when not on your home network, in Mbps.

web.access.revokeBody.text: Apa pun yang memakai kunci ini berhenti berfungsi sekaligus. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
web.access.revokeBody.source: Anything using this key stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

web.access.roleConfirmAdmin.text: {name} akan dapat mengelola orang di server ini dan melihat setiap pustaka.
web.access.roleConfirmAdmin.source: {name} will be able to manage people on this server and see every library.

web.access.roleConfirmMember.text: {name} akan kembali menjadi anggota, dan hanya dapat mengakses pustaka yang dibagikan kepadanya.
web.access.roleConfirmMember.source: {name} will go back to being a member, with only the libraries shared with them.

web.access.sendTo.text: Kirim tautan ini ke {email}. Berlaku sekali dan tidak ditampilkan lagi.
web.access.sendTo.source: Send this link to {email}. It works once and is not shown again.

web.access.sendToAnyone.text: Kirim tautan ini kepada orang yang Anda undang. Berlaku sekali dan tidak ditampilkan lagi.
web.access.sendToAnyone.source: Send this link to the person you’re inviting. It works once and is not shown again.

web.account.export.downloaded.text: Telah diunduh. Simpan berkas di tempat privat.
web.account.export.downloaded.source: Downloaded. Keep the file somewhere private.

web.account.export.help.text: Salinan data Portico Account Anda, sebagai berkas JSON.
web.account.export.help.source: A copy of your Portico Account data, as a JSON file.

web.account.export.preparing.text: Data akun Anda masih disiapkan. Data akan ada di Notifikasi setelah siap.
web.account.export.preparing.source: Your account data is still being prepared. It will be in Notifications when it’s ready.

web.account.manageHostedBody.text: Kata sandi, metode masuk, perangkat, profil, dan keamanan ada di Portico Account Anda.
web.account.manageHostedBody.source: Password, sign-in methods, devices, profiles and security live on your Portico Account.

web.account.notif.emptyBody.text: Perubahan keamanan, sesi masuk baru, dan kabar tentang server Anda tampil di sini.
web.account.notif.emptyBody.source: Security changes, new sign-ins and news about your servers appear here.

web.account.notif.joinedBody.source: An invitation you sent was accepted.

web.account.notif.newDeviceBody.text: Jika itu bukan Anda, keluarkan dan ubah kata sandi Anda.
web.account.notif.newDeviceBody.source: If this wasn’t you, sign it out and change your password.

web.account.notif.prefServerOffline.source: A server that has gone quiet

web.account.notif.prefsHelp.text: Perubahan keamanan dan sesi masuk baru selalu ditampilkan.
web.account.notif.prefsHelp.source: Security changes and new sign-ins are always shown.

web.account.notif.securityBody.text: Jika itu bukan Anda, tinjau perangkat Anda dan ubah kata sandi Anda.
web.account.notif.securityBody.source: If it wasn’t you, review your devices and change your password.

web.account.notif.serverOfflineBody.text: Portico sudah lama tidak mendengar kabar dari server ini. Periksa daya dan koneksi jaringannya.
web.account.notif.serverOfflineBody.source: Portico hasn’t heard from this server for a while. Check its power and network connection.

web.account.notif.storageBody.text: Kosongkan ruang sebelum menambahkan media lagi.
web.account.notif.storageBody.source: Free up space before adding more media.

web.account.ownerResetsPassword.text: Jika Anda lupa kata sandi, pemilik server dapat mengatur ulangnya.
web.account.ownerResetsPassword.source: If you forget your password, the server’s owner can reset it.

web.account.passwordChangedBody.text: Kata sandi baru Anda berlaku mulai sekarang. Perangkat yang sudah masuk tetap masuk; keluarkan di bawah jika perlu.
web.account.passwordChangedBody.source: Your new password works from now on. Devices that are already signed in stay signed in; sign them out below if you need to.

web.account.passwordHelp.text: Dipakai untuk masuk ke server ini
web.account.passwordHelp.source: Used to sign in to this server

web.account.porticoMemberBody.text: Anda masuk ke server ini dengan Portico Account, sehingga kata sandi dan verifikasi dua langkah Anda dikelola di sana. Profil, PIN, dan perangkat yang masuk dikelola di sini.
web.account.porticoMemberBody.source: You sign in to this server with your Portico Account, so your password and two-step verification are managed there. Profiles, PINs and signed-in devices are managed here.

web.account.porticoMemberTitle.text: Kata sandi dan verifikasi dua langkah

web.account.profilesHelp.text: Setiap profil menyimpan riwayat, Daftar Saya, dan preferensinya sendiri.
web.account.profilesHelp.source: Each profile keeps its own history, My List and preferences.

web.account.profilesHostedHelp.text: Setiap profil menyimpan riwayat, Daftar Saya, dan preferensinya sendiri. Tambah, ganti nama, dan hapus di Portico Account Anda.
web.account.profilesHostedHelp.source: Each profile keeps its own history, My List and preferences. Add, rename and remove them in your Portico Account.

web.accountReturn.body.text: Kembali ke aplikasi Portico untuk menyelesaikan proses masuk.
web.accountReturn.body.source: Returning to the Portico app to finish signing in.

web.accountReturn.invalid.text: Mulai masuk lagi di aplikasi Portico.
web.accountReturn.invalid.source: Start signing in again in the Portico app.

web.accountReturn.invalidTitle.text: Proses masuk ini tidak dapat dilanjutkan

web.activity.noTasksBody.text: Pemindaian, pemuatan ulang metadata, dan pemeliharaan tampil di sini saat berjalan.
web.activity.noTasksBody.source: Scans, metadata refreshes and maintenance appear here as they run.

web.alerts.certificateWarningHelp.text: Hari sebelumnya. Sertifikat diperbarui sendiri; peringatan hanya berbunyi jika pembaruan macet.
web.alerts.certificateWarningHelp.source: Days ahead. Certificates renew by themselves; this only fires if renewal is stuck.

web.alerts.lede.text: Saat server menaruh peringatan di notifikasi Anda.
web.alerts.lede.source: When the server puts a warning in your notifications.

web.alerts.storageCriticalHelp.text: Rekaman dan konversi dapat mulai gagal pada titik ini
web.alerts.storageCriticalHelp.source: Recordings and conversions may start failing at this point

web.alerts.storageWarning.text: Peringatkan saat ruang bebas di bawah
web.alerts.storageWarning.source: Warn when free space falls below

web.alerts.storageWarningHelp.source: Percent of a drive that is still free

web.broadcast.bodyTooLong.text: Pesan maksimal 1000 byte; yang ini {count} byte.
web.broadcast.bodyTooLong.source: Messages can be at most 1000 bytes; this one is {count} bytes.

web.broadcast.lede.text: Tampil di notifikasi setiap orang. Ini bukan email.
web.broadcast.lede.source: Appears in each person’s notifications. It is not an email.

web.broadcast.titleExample.text: Server akan mati pada Sabtu pagi
web.broadcast.titleExample.source: The server will be down on Saturday morning

web.broadcast.titleTooLong.text: Judul maksimal 200 byte; yang ini {count} byte.
web.broadcast.titleTooLong.source: Titles can be at most 200 bytes; this one is {count} bytes.

web.browser.unsupportedBody.text: Portico memerlukan Chrome atau Edge 111, Firefox 113, Safari 16.4 atau yang lebih baru. Perbarui browser ini atau buka Portico di browser lain.
web.browser.unsupportedBody.source: Portico needs Chrome or Edge 111, Firefox 113, Safari 16.4 or newer. Update this browser or open Portico in another one.

web.browser.unsupportedTitle.text: Browser ini terlalu lawas untuk Portico
web.browser.unsupportedTitle.source: This browser is too old for Portico

web.capabilities.help.text: Apa yang dapat dilakukan server ini saat ini, dan mengapa tidak jika tidak bisa.
web.capabilities.help.source: What this server can do right now, and why not when it can’t.

web.capabilities.notChecked.text: Server belum memeriksa ini. Pemeriksaan dilakukan saat fitur pertama dipakai atau disiapkan.
web.capabilities.notChecked.source: The server hasn’t checked this yet. It does when the feature is first used or set up.

web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxOf.text: Pemilik server mematikan isolasi untuk perangkat video.
web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxOf.source: The server owner turned off isolation for the video tools.

web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxUn.text: Host ini tidak dapat mengisolasi perangkat video, sehingga konversi berjalan dengan perlindungan dasar.
web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxUn.source: This host can’t isolate the video tools, so conversions run with baseline protections.

web.capabilities.reason.delivery.text: Pemutaran saluran belum disiapkan di server ini.
web.capabilities.reason.delivery.source: Channel playback isn’t set up on this server.

web.capabilities.reason.dependencies.text: Perangkat video terpasang, tetapi beberapa pustaka yang dibutuhkannya tidak ditemukan.
web.capabilities.reason.dependencies.source: The video tools are installed, but some of the libraries they need can’t be found.

web.capabilities.reason.dolbyVisionAppro.text: Server ini mengonversi Dolby Vision dengan warna perkiraan pada layar yang tidak dapat menampilkannya.
web.capabilities.reason.dolbyVisionAppro.source: This server converts Dolby Vision with approximate colors on screens that can’t show it.

web.capabilities.reason.hardware.text: Enkoder perangkat keras yang Anda pilih tidak dapat dipakai di server ini, sehingga prosesor dipakai sebagai gantinya.
web.capabilities.reason.hardware.source: The hardware encoder you chose isn’t usable on this server, so the processor is used instead.

web.capabilities.reason.other.text: Portico tidak dapat menyalakannya di sini. Detail teknis memiliki penyebabnya.
web.capabilities.reason.other.source: Portico couldn’t turn this on here. Technical details has the cause.

web.capabilities.reason.platform.text: Sistem operasi server ini belum dapat mengisolasi perangkat video yang dibutuhkan Portico untuk ini.
web.capabilities.reason.platform.source: This server’s operating system can’t isolate the video tools Portico needs for this yet.

web.capabilities.reason.tools.text: FFmpeg dan ffprobe belum disiapkan di server ini.
web.capabilities.reason.tools.source: FFmpeg and ffprobe aren’t set up on this server.

web.channelBuilder.templatesFailed.text: Templat tidak dapat dimuat. Coba lagi

web.channelProblem.general.text: Saluran ini tidak dapat diputar saat ini. Coba lagi, atau pilih saluran lain.
web.channelProblem.general.source: This channel can’t play right now. Try again, or pick another channel.

web.channelProblem.sourceUnavailable.text: Sumber saluran tidak merespons. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
web.channelProblem.sourceUnavailable.source: The channel’s source isn’t responding. Try again in a minute.

web.channelProblem.stalled.text: Saluran terlalu lama bersiap. Coba lagi.
web.channelProblem.stalled.source: The channel took too long to get ready. Try again.

web.channelProblem.startFailed.text: Server tidak dapat memulai saluran ini. Coba lagi, atau pilih saluran lain.
web.channelProblem.startFailed.source: The server couldn’t start this channel. Try again, or pick another channel.

web.channelProblem.storage.text: Server tidak memiliki ruang untuk menyangga TV langsung saat ini. Pemilik dapat mengosongkan ruang di Server › Penyimpanan.
web.channelProblem.storage.source: The server has no room to buffer live TV right now. The owner can free up space in Server › Storage.

web.channelProblem.tunersBusy.text: Semua tuner sibuk merekam atau dipakai. Coba lagi saat ada yang bebas.
web.channelProblem.tunersBusy.source: All tuners are busy recording or in use. Try again when one frees up.

web.chooser.accountWaitingBody.text: Portico Account tidak menjawab saat ini. {server} tidak terpengaruh; Portico akan membukanya segera setelah mereka kembali.
web.chooser.accountWaitingBody.source: Portico Accounts aren’t answering right now. {server} isn’t affected; Portico will open it as soon as they’re back.

web.chooser.lede.source: Choose the server to watch from.

web.chooser.noneBody.text: Siapkan server Portico dan sambungkan ke akun ini, atau buka undangan dari pemilik server.
web.chooser.noneBody.source: Set up a Portico server and connect it to this account, or open an invitation from a server’s owner.

web.chooser.signInDirectly.source: Sign in directly to this server

web.chooser.waitingBody.text: Portico akan tersambung otomatis saat server kembali.
web.chooser.waitingBody.source: Portico will connect automatically when it’s back.

web.claim.checkAddress.text: Setujui hanya jika Anda memulainya dari server Anda sendiri dan alamat di atas milik Anda.
web.claim.checkAddress.source: Approve only if you started this from your own server and the address above is yours.

web.claim.closed.text: Koneksi tidak disetujui. Anda dapat mencoba lagi.
web.claim.closed.source: The connection wasn’t approved. You can try again.

web.claim.connected.text: {server} tersambung ke Portico Account Anda. Server sedang mendapatkan koneksi amannya dan menyelesaikan penyiapan sendiri.
web.claim.connected.source: {server} is connected to your Portico Account. It is getting its secure connection now and finishes setting up on its own.

web.claim.denied.text: Anda menolak. {server} tidak tersambung. Anda dapat menutup jendela ini.
web.claim.denied.source: You declined. {server} isn’t connected. You can close this window.

web.claim.errorInvalid.text: Permintaan koneksi itu tidak valid. Mulai lagi dari server.
web.claim.errorInvalid.source: That connection request wasn’t valid. Start again from the server.

web.claim.errorStale.text: Permintaan koneksi itu sudah dijawab atau telah kedaluwarsa. Mulai lagi.
web.claim.errorStale.source: That connection request was already answered or has expired. Start again.

web.claim.errorTooMany.text: Server ini sudah memiliki tiga permintaan koneksi yang menunggu. Setujui atau tolak satu, atau tunggu 10 menit hingga kedaluwarsa.
web.claim.errorTooMany.source: This server already has three connection requests waiting. Approve or deny one, or wait 10 minutes for them to expire.

web.claim.errorUnavailable.text: Server ini tidak dapat disambungkan saat ini. Coba lagi sebentar lagi.
web.claim.errorUnavailable.source: This server can’t be connected right now. Try again in a moment.

web.claim.expired.text: Permintaan koneksi ini telah kedaluwarsa atau sudah dijawab. Mulai lagi dari server.
web.claim.expired.source: This connection request has expired or was already answered. Start again from the server.

web.claim.lede.text: Penyambungan memungkinkan orang masuk dengan Portico Account mereka, menjangkau server ini dari jauh, dan tersambung dengan aman. Server mendapatkan sertifikatnya sendiri.
web.claim.lede.source: Connecting lets people sign in with their Portico Account, reach this server away from home and connect to it securely. The server gets its certificate by itself.

web.claim.notFound.text: Permintaan koneksi ini bukan untuk Portico Account Anda, atau sudah tidak ada. Periksa bahwa Anda masuk ke akun yang tepat, atau mulai lagi dari server.
web.claim.notFound.source: This connection request isn’t for your Portico Account, or it no longer exists. Check you’re signed in to the right account, or start again from the server.

web.claim.openFromServer.text: Buka halaman ini dari server Anda: penyiapan awalnya, atau Pengaturan › Akses jarak jauh › Koneksi aman.
web.claim.openFromServer.source: Open this page from your server: its first-run setup, or Settings › Remote access › Secure connection.

web.claim.ownerProfileHelp.text: Profil yang memiliki server dan dapat mengelolanya.
web.claim.ownerProfileHelp.source: The profile that owns the server and can manage it.

web.claim.signInFirst.text: Masuk ke Portico Account yang akan memiliki server ini.
web.claim.signInFirst.source: Sign in to the Portico Account that will own this server.

web.claim.waiting.text: Setujui koneksi di jendela Portico Account. Halaman ini diperbarui setelah Anda melakukannya.
web.claim.waiting.source: Approve the connection in the Portico Account window. This page updates when you do.

web.connection.mismatchBody.text: Ada hal lain yang menjawab di alamat {server}, sehingga halaman ini dijeda. Portico terus mencoba menjangkau server Anda dan mengembalikan halaman saat server menjawab. Pengaturan, akun Anda, dan penggantian server tetap berfungsi.
web.connection.mismatchBody.source: Something else is answering at the address of {server}, so this page is paused. Portico keeps trying to reach your server and brings the page back when it answers. Settings, your account and switching servers still work.

web.connection.reconnectingBody.text: {server} tidak menjawab saat ini. Portico terus mencoba dan membukanya segera setelah tersambung ulang. Pengaturan, akun Anda, dan penggantian server tetap berfungsi.
web.connection.reconnectingBody.source: {server} isn’t answering right now. Portico keeps trying and opens it as soon as it reconnects. Settings, your account and switching servers still work.

web.connection.replacedBody.text: Ada hal lain yang menjawab di alamat {server}. Portico terus mencoba menjangkau server Anda. Jika server itu disiapkan ulang dari awal, pilih “Gunakan akun atau server lain” dan masuk ke server itu.
web.connection.replacedBody.source: Something else is answering at the address of {server}. Portico keeps trying to reach your server. If it was set up again from scratch, choose “Use another account or server” and sign in to it.

web.connectivity.customCertInvalid.text: Berkas itu bukan pasangan sertifikat dan kunci PEM yang cocok.
web.connectivity.customCertInvalid.source: The files aren’t a matching PEM certificate and key.

web.connectivity.customCertMismatch.source: The certificate doesn’t cover this domain.

web.connectivity.customCertUnreadable.text: Berkas sertifikat atau kunci tidak dapat dibaca. Periksa jalur dan pastikan server dapat membacanya.
web.connectivity.customCertUnreadable.source: The certificate or key file can’t be read. Check the paths and that the server can read them.

web.connectivity.discovery.text: Temukan server ini di jaringan rumah
web.connectivity.discovery.source: Find this server on the home network

web.connectivity.httpOutsideHome.text: Koneksi ini memakai HTTP di luar jaringan rumah Anda.
web.connectivity.httpOutsideHome.source: This connection uses HTTP outside your home networks.

web.connectivity.interfaceHelp.text: Antarmuka jaringan yang dipakai aplikasi di jaringan rumah Anda. Otomatis melewati jaringan kontainer dan virtual.
web.connectivity.interfaceHelp.source: Which network interface apps on your home network use. Automatic skips container and virtual networks.

web.connectivity.outsideLede.text: Aturan untuk perangkat yang tidak ada di jaringan rumah Anda.
web.connectivity.outsideLede.source: Rules for devices that are not on your home network.

web.connectivity.pausedLimitHelp.text: Membebaskan stream untuk orang lain. Penonton dapat melanjutkan dari titik berhenti. Musik, buku audio, dan TV Langsung tidak pernah diakhiri.
web.connectivity.pausedLimitHelp.source: Frees the stream for someone else. The viewer can pick up where they left off. Music, audiobooks and Live TV are never ended.

web.connectivity.qualityLimit.text: Batas kualitas saat jauh dari rumah

web.connectivity.whoMaySignIn.text: Siapa yang boleh masuk dari luar
web.connectivity.whoMaySignIn.source: Who may sign in from outside

web.console.jobFailed.text: Pekerjaan ini tidak selesai. Log memiliki detailnya.
web.console.jobFailed.source: This job didn’t finish. Logs has the details.

web.console.nav.channelsLede.text: Saluran selalu aktif yang dibuat dari pustaka Anda.
web.console.nav.channelsLede.source: Always-on channels generated from your libraries.

web.console.nav.feedbackLede.text: Masalah yang dilaporkan penonton dari aplikasinya.
web.console.nav.feedbackLede.source: Problems viewers reported from their apps.

web.console.nav.librariesLede.source: What the server knows about and where it comes from.

web.console.nav.storageLede.text: Penyimpanan jarak jauh yang terpasang ke server ini.
web.console.nav.storageLede.source: Remote storage attached to this server.

web.console.ownerBody.text: Minta pemilik membagikan yang Anda butuhkan, atau masuk dengan akun pemilik.
web.console.ownerBody.source: Ask the owner to share what you need, or sign in with the owner account.

web.console.ownerTitle.text: Hanya pemilik server yang dapat mengelola server ini
web.console.ownerTitle.source: Only the server owner can manage this server

web.continue.failed.text: “{title}” tidak dapat dihapus dari Lanjutkan Menonton. Coba lagi.
web.continue.failed.source: “{title}” couldn’t be removed from Continue Watching. Try again.

web.continue.undoFailed.text: “{title}” tidak dapat dikembalikan ke Lanjutkan Menonton. Putar untuk melanjutkan dari titik berhenti.
web.continue.undoFailed.source: “{title}” couldn’t be put back on Continue Watching. Play it to pick up where you left off.

web.custody.body.text: Anda kini pemilik {server}. Terima agar Portico Account Anda memegang pendaftarannya, yang mencakup akses jarak jauh dan undangan.
web.custody.body.source: You’re the owner of {server} now. Accept so your Portico Account holds its registration, which covers remote access and invitations.

web.custody.title.text: Terima kepemilikan atas pendaftaran Portico server ini
web.custody.title.source: Accept ownership of this server’s Portico registration

web.deleteAccount.cannot.text: Akun ini tidak dapat dihapus saat ini. Coba lagi nanti.
web.deleteAccount.cannot.source: This account can’t be deleted right now. Try again later.

web.deleteAccount.doneBody.text: Anda keluar dari Portico Account. Server yang Anda ikuti diminta menghapus data Anda.
web.deleteAccount.doneBody.source: You’re signed out of your Portico Account. Servers you were on are told to remove your data.

web.deleteAccount.help.text: Menghapus akun Anda, profilnya, dan akses Anda ke setiap server di dalamnya. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
web.deleteAccount.help.source: Removes your account, its profiles and your access to every server on it. This can’t be undone.

web.deleteAccount.member.text: {count, plural, one {Anda kehilangan akses ke # server yang mengundang Anda.} other {Anda kehilangan akses ke # server yang mengundang Anda.}}
web.deleteAccount.member.source: {count, plural, one {You lose access to # server you were invited to.} other {You lose access to # servers you were invited to.}}

web.deleteAccount.mismatch.text: Itu tidak cocok. Ketik {value} persis seperti ditampilkan.
web.deleteAccount.mismatch.source: That doesn’t match. Type {value} exactly as shown.

web.deleteAccount.owned.text: {count, plural, one {Anda memiliki {servers}. Server itu keluar dari akun Anda, dan data pribadinya dihapus.} other {Anda memiliki # server ({servers}). Server itu keluar dari akun Anda, dan data pribadinya dihapus.}}
web.deleteAccount.owned.source: {count, plural, one {You own {servers}. It leaves your account, and its personal data is deleted.} other {You own # servers ({servers}). They leave your account, and their personal data is deleted.}}

web.deleteAccount.profiles.text: {count, plural, one {Profil Anda dihapus.} other {# profil Anda dihapus.}}
web.deleteAccount.profiles.source: {count, plural, one {Your profile is deleted.} other {Your # profiles are deleted.}}

web.device.approveWarn.text: Setujui hanya jika detail ini cocok dengan perangkat di depan Anda. Perangkat akan masuk sebagai Anda.
web.device.approveWarn.source: Approve only if these details match the device in front of you. It will be signed in as you.

web.device.deniedBody.text: Pemilik {server} menolak browser ini. Minta mereka mengizinkannya di Server › Akses, lalu periksa lagi.
web.device.deniedBody.source: The owner of {server} has refused this browser. Ask them to allow it under Server › Access, then check again.

web.device.deniedTitle.source: The owner turned this browser away

web.device.lede.text: Ketik kode yang tampil di TV untuk memasukkannya.
web.device.lede.source: Type the code shown on the TV to sign it in.

web.device.notFound.text: Kode itu tidak ditemukan. Periksa di TV dan coba lagi.
web.device.notFound.source: That code wasn’t found. Check it on the TV and try again.

web.device.signIn.text: Masuk ke Portico Account Anda untuk memasukkan TV.
web.device.signIn.source: Sign in to your Portico Account to sign the TV in.

web.device.timeoutKept.source: The request timed out. Your code is kept.

web.devices.approvalBody.text: Perangkat ini masuk tetapi tidak dapat menelusuri atau memutar hingga Anda menyetujuinya.
web.devices.approvalBody.source: This device signed in but can’t browse or play until you approve it.

web.devices.everywhereBody.text: Setiap perangkat, termasuk yang ini, keluar dari server ini. Unduhan yang sudah ada di perangkat tetap ada hingga perangkat tersambung lagi.
web.devices.everywhereBody.source: Every device, including this one, is signed out of this server. Downloads already on a device stay until it next connects.

web.devices.trustedHelp.text: Melewati persetujuan saat perangkat ini masuk lagi.
web.devices.trustedHelp.source: Skips approval the next time this device signs in.

web.diagnostics.clientReportBudget.text: Batas log klien harian telah tercapai.
web.diagnostics.clientReportBudget.source: The daily client log limit has been reached.

web.diagnostics.clientReportDevice.text: Masuk di perangkat ini untuk mengunggah log.
web.diagnostics.clientReportDevice.source: Sign in on this device to upload logs.

web.direct.codeLede.text: Verifikasi dua langkah aktif untuk akun ini. Masukkan kode dari aplikasi autentikator Anda, atau kode pemulihan.
web.direct.codeLede.source: Two-step verification is on for this account. Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

web.direct.lede.text: Gunakan akun yang ada di server Anda. Akun itu hanya dipakai antara browser ini dan server itu.
web.direct.lede.source: Use an account that lives on your server. It stays between this browser and that server.

web.direct.ledeBundled.source: Use an account that lives on {host}.

web.direct.newPasswordLede.text: Pemilik server meminta Anda memilih kata sandi baru sebelum melanjutkan.
web.direct.newPasswordLede.source: The server’s owner asked you to choose a new password before you continue.

web.direct.recoveryHelp.text: Lupa kata sandi ini? Di komputer server, jalankan portico-server recover-owner.
web.direct.recoveryHelp.source: Forgot this password? On the server’s computer, run portico-server recover-owner.

web.direct.recoveryLede.text: Gunakan akun pemilik yang tersimpan di server ini saat Portico Account tidak dapat dijangkau.
web.direct.recoveryLede.source: Use the owner account stored on this server when Portico Accounts can’t be reached.

web.direct.rememberProfile.text: Ingat profil ini di tab browser ini
web.direct.rememberProfile.source: Remember this profile in this browser tab

web.directJoin.body.text: Anda diundang ke {server}. Pilih nama pengguna dan kata sandi untuk membuat akun Anda.
web.directJoin.body.source: You’ve been invited to {server}. Choose a username and password to create your account.

web.directJoin.bodyPortico.text: Anda diundang ke {server}. Gabung dengan Portico Account Anda.
web.directJoin.bodyPortico.source: You’ve been invited to {server}. Join with your Portico Account.

web.directJoin.bodyPorticoUnnamed.text: Anda diundang ke server Portico. Gabung dengan Portico Account Anda.
web.directJoin.bodyPorticoUnnamed.source: You’ve been invited to a Portico server. Join with your Portico Account.

web.directJoin.bodyUnnamed.text: Masukkan alamat server dan kode undangan Anda, lalu pilih nama pengguna dan kata sandi.
web.directJoin.bodyUnnamed.source: Enter the server’s address and your invitation code, then choose a username and password.

web.directJoin.error.expired.text: Undangan ini telah kedaluwarsa atau sudah dipakai. Minta yang baru kepada pemilik.
web.directJoin.error.expired.source: This invitation has expired or was already used. Ask the owner for a new one.

web.directJoin.error.invalid.text: Periksa kode undangan dan nama pengguna: 3 hingga 64 karakter, tanpa spasi atau @.
web.directJoin.error.invalid.source: Check the invitation code and username: 3 to 64 characters, no spaces or @.

web.directJoin.error.taken.text: Nama pengguna itu sudah dipakai. Pilih yang lain.
web.directJoin.error.taken.source: That username is taken. Choose another.

web.directJoin.error.tooMany.text: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Tunggu sebentar, lalu coba lagi.
web.directJoin.error.tooMany.source: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

web.directJoin.forAccount.text: Undangan ini dibuat untuk satu Portico Account. Gabung dengan akun yang dikirimi undangan.
web.directJoin.forAccount.source: This invitation was made for one Portico Account. Join with the account it was sent to.

web.directJoin.forAccountHere.text: Anda diundang ke {server} dengan Portico Account Anda. Portico Account masuk di aplikasi web Portico, yang kemudian menyambungkan Anda ke server ini.
web.directJoin.forAccountHere.source: You’ve been invited to {server} with your Portico Account. Portico Accounts sign in on the Portico web app, which then connects you to this server.

web.directJoin.have.text: Punya undangan? Gabung ke server ini
web.directJoin.have.source: Have an invitation? Join this server

web.directJoin.nameHelp.text: Ditampilkan di profil Anda. Anda dapat mengubahnya nanti.
web.directJoin.nameHelp.source: Shown on your profile. You can change it later.

web.directJoin.openInPortico.source: Continue in the Portico web app

web.directJoin.usernameHelp.text: Anda masuk dengannya. 3 hingga 64 karakter, tanpa spasi atau @.
web.directJoin.usernameHelp.source: You sign in with it. 3 to 64 characters, no spaces or @.

web.directJoin.withPassword.text: Gabung dengan nama pengguna dan kata sandi saja
web.directJoin.withPassword.source: Join with a username and password instead

web.downloads.emptyBody.text: Buka menu judul lalu pilih Unduh. Server menyiapkan berkas, lalu Anda dapat menyimpannya.
web.downloads.emptyBody.source: Open a title’s menu and choose Download. The server prepares the file, then you can save it.

web.downloads.goneFromServer.text: Judul ini tidak lagi ada di server.
web.downloads.goneFromServer.source: This title is no longer on the server.

web.downloads.keepNext.text: Simpan {count, plural, one {# episode} other {# episode}} berikutnya
web.downloads.keepNext.source: Keep the next {count, plural, one {# episode} other {# episodes}}

web.downloads.minutesLeft.source: {count, plural, one {about # min left} other {about # min left}}

web.downloads.noDevice.text: Sesi browser ini tidak dapat memulai unduhan acara utuh. Unduh judul satu per satu saja.

web.downloads.offMember.text: Tanyakan kepada pemilik server jika Anda ingin menyimpan judul untuk ditonton luring.
web.downloads.offMember.source: Ask the server’s owner if you’d like to save titles to watch offline.

web.downloads.offOwner.text: Unduhan dimatikan di server ini, sehingga judul tidak dapat disiapkan untuk disimpan.
web.downloads.offOwner.source: Downloads are turned off on this server, so titles can’t be prepared for saving.

web.dvr.cancelBody.text: Judul tidak akan direkam. Aturan seri, jika ada, tetap berlaku.
web.dvr.cancelBody.source: It won’t be recorded. A series rule, if there is one, stays in place.

web.dvr.captureOff.text: Server ini tidak dapat merekam saat ini. Rekaman terjadwal dimulai setelah memungkinkan.
web.dvr.captureOff.source: This server can’t record right now. Scheduled recordings start once it can.

web.dvr.conflictBody.text: Rekaman ini memakai tuner pada saat yang sama.
web.dvr.conflictBody.source: These recordings are using the tuners at the same time.

web.dvr.deleteBody.text: Rekaman ({size}) dihapus dari server. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
web.dvr.deleteBody.source: The recording ({size}) is deleted from the server. This can’t be undone.

web.dvr.deleteBodyInUse.text: Ada yang menontonnya. Rekaman dihapus ({size}) setelah mereka berhenti. Tindakan ini tidak dapat diurungkan.
web.dvr.deleteBodyInUse.source: Someone is watching it. It’s deleted ({size}) once they stop. This can’t be undone.

web.dvr.deleteBodyKept.text: Anda memilih menyimpan rekaman ini. Menghapusnya membebaskan {size} dan tidak dapat diurungkan.
web.dvr.deleteBodyKept.source: You chose to keep this recording. Deleting it frees {size} and can’t be undone.

web.dvr.deleteRuleBody.text: Rekaman yang sudah dibuatnya disimpan. Pilih apa yang terjadi pada yang sudah dijadwalkan.
web.dvr.deleteRuleBody.source: Recordings it already made are kept. Choose what happens to the ones it has scheduled.

web.dvr.empty.recordedBody.text: Rekaman tampil di sini setelah selesai.
web.dvr.empty.recordedBody.source: Recordings appear here once they finish.

web.dvr.empty.rulesBody.text: Pilih Rekam seri pada program di panduan agar terus merekam episode baru.
web.dvr.empty.rulesBody.source: Choose Record series on a program in the guide to keep recording new episodes.

web.dvr.empty.upcomingBody.text: Buka program di panduan lalu pilih Rekam.
web.dvr.empty.upcomingBody.source: Open a program in the guide and choose Record.

web.dvr.error.access.text: Akses rekaman Anda berubah. Periksa profil yang Anda pakai, lalu coba lagi.
web.dvr.error.access.source: Your recording access changed. Check the profile you’re using, then try again.

web.dvr.error.changed.text: Rekaman ini berubah sejak Anda membukanya. Muat ulang dan pilih lagi.
web.dvr.error.changed.source: This recording changed since you opened it. Refresh and choose again.

web.dvr.error.unsupported.text: Server tidak dapat merekam ini dengan penyiapan panduan atau penyimpanan saat ini.
web.dvr.error.unsupported.source: The server can’t record this with the current guide or storage setup.

web.dvr.reason.conflict.text: Rekaman lain memakai setiap tuner pada waktu ini.
web.dvr.reason.conflict.source: Other recordings are using every tuner at this time.

web.dvr.reason.guideMissing.text: Program ini tidak lagi ada di panduan.
web.dvr.reason.guideMissing.source: This program is no longer in the guide.

web.dvr.reason.inUse.text: Menunggu hingga tidak ada yang menontonnya.
web.dvr.reason.inUse.source: Waiting until nobody is watching it.

web.dvr.reason.missed.text: Program berakhir sebelum rekaman dapat dimulai.
web.dvr.reason.missed.source: The program ended before recording could start.

web.dvr.reason.partial.source: Only part of the program was recorded.

web.dvr.reason.removeRetry.source: The file couldn’t be removed yet. Portico will try again.

web.dvr.reason.sourceChanged.source: The source changed during recording. What was captured is kept.

web.dvr.writeUnhealthyOwner.source: Check the recording folder in Server › Live TV & DVR.

web.dvrSettings.bufferHelp.text: Detik yang ditahan sebelum diputar. Lebih banyak meredam sumber yang goyah; lebih sedikit lebih dekat ke siaran langsung.

web.dvrSettings.convertSmaller.text: Konversi ke berkas yang lebih kecil

web.dvrSettings.defaultsLede.text: Yang dilakukan rekaman baru kecuali Anda menentukan lain.
web.dvrSettings.defaultsLede.source: What a new recording does unless you say otherwise.

web.dvrSettings.discovery.source: Look for tuners on the network

web.dvrSettings.finishLateHelp.text: Menit setelah akhir tercantum. Olahraga langsung sering molor.
web.dvrSettings.finishLateHelp.source: Minutes after the listed end. Live sport often overruns.

web.dvrSettings.goneHelp.text: Profil ini tidak lagi tersedia. Izinnya yang ada dapat ditarik.
web.dvrSettings.goneHelp.source: This profile is no longer available. Its existing permission can be withdrawn.

web.dvrSettings.guideDaysHelp.source: How far ahead the guide is kept.

web.dvrSettings.inheritHelp.text: Hanya profil dengan akses server saat ini yang dapat mewarisi. Penolakan eksplisit tetap menang.

web.dvrSettings.inheritRow.text: Biarkan profil lain di akun ini mewarisi
web.dvrSettings.inheritRow.source: Let other profiles on this account inherit

web.dvrSettings.liveDefaultsLede.text: Cara server menyetel dan mempertahankan stream.
web.dvrSettings.liveDefaultsLede.source: How the server tunes and keeps a stream going.

web.dvrSettings.noTuners.text: Belum ada tuner. Tambahkan sumber TV Langsung terlebih dahulu.
web.dvrSettings.noTuners.source: No tuners yet. Add a Live TV source first.

web.dvrSettings.retryWindowHelp.text: Detik untuk terus mencoba sumber yang terputus sebelum menyerah.
web.dvrSettings.retryWindowHelp.source: Seconds to keep trying a source that drops before giving up.

web.dvrSettings.tunersLede.text: Dipakai sekarang dan selama {hours} jam ke depan.
web.dvrSettings.tunersLede.source: In use now and over the next {hours} hours.

web.dvrSettings.userAgentHelp.source: Some providers only answer a particular player. Leave empty for Portico’s own.

web.dvrSettings.whoCanRecordLede.text: Pilih profil mana yang boleh menjadwalkan rekaman. Pemilik server tidak otomatis termasuk. Pengaturan pada profil lebih utama daripada pengaturan akunnya.
web.dvrSettings.whoCanRecordLede.source: Choose which profiles may schedule recordings. The server owner isn’t included automatically. A setting on a profile takes priority over its account’s setting.

web.empty.homeMemberBody.text: Judul tampil di sini setelah pemilik menambahkan media ke pustaka yang dapat Anda lihat.
web.empty.homeMemberBody.source: Titles appear here once the owner adds media to the libraries you can see.

web.empty.homeOwnerBody.text: Judul tampil di sini setelah pustaka Anda dipindai.
web.empty.homeOwnerBody.source: Titles appear here once your libraries have been scanned.

web.empty.homeTitle.text: Belum ada apa pun di sini

web.empty.libraryMemberBody.source: Titles appear here once the owner adds media to this library.

web.empty.libraryOwnerBody.source: Titles appear here as the server scans this library’s folders. You can start a scan from the library’s settings.

web.empty.memberBody.text: Minta pemilik server ini membagikan pustaka dengan profil Anda.
web.empty.memberBody.source: Ask the owner of this server to share a library with your profile.

web.empty.ownerBody.source: Point Portico at a folder of movies, shows, music or audiobooks. Your files stay where they are.

web.empty.searchOwnerTitle.source: Add a library to search it

web.entity.emptyBody.source: The server has no items for this page yet.

web.entry.collectionAddFailed.source: This item couldn’t be added to the collection. Check that it’s available and that you have access to it.

web.entry.collectionAddUnconfirmed.source: The server didn’t confirm that this item was added. Open the collection again to check.

web.general.accountConnectionHelp.text: Menyambungkan server ke Portico Account mengaktifkan koneksi aman, akses jarak jauh, undangan, dan perpindahan antar server.
web.general.accountConnectionHelp.source: Connecting the server to a Portico Account enables a secure connection, remote access, invitations and switching between servers.

web.general.approvalWaiting.text: Persetujuan menunggu di Portico Account Anda.
web.general.approvalWaiting.source: Approval is waiting on your Portico Account.

web.general.connectHelp.text: Membuka Portico Account Anda di jendela baru, tempat Anda menyetujui server ini. Permintaan yang menunggu dapat diperiksa atau dibatalkan di sini.

web.general.recoveryOwnerHelp.text: Akun pemilik lokal tetap tersedia untuk pemulihan meski server tersambung.
web.general.recoveryOwnerHelp.source: A local owner account remains available for recovery even when the server is connected.

web.general.serverNameHelp.text: Ditampilkan di setiap perangkat yang tersambung dan di Portico Account Anda.
web.general.serverNameHelp.source: Shown on every device that connects and in your Portico Account.
